a: Tinach hecha denasa met veachar kach nasa chay. demiggo deishteri issur eshet ach — ishteri name issur achot ishsha.
Ella nasa chay, veachar kach nasa met — issur achot ishsha kadem.
Vaafillu nasa met name, tinach hecha denasa met, umet, veachar kach nasa chay — dechazya leh devene bene. ella nasa met, velo met, veachar kach nasa chay — la ichazya leh kelal.
Mi la mode ulla sheim raa keri belel shemini, sheen machnis yadav labbehonot, shello yatza beshaa shehi reuya lehavi bah korban.
Ella: ki itzterich "aleha" — hecha denasa met, umet, veachar kach nasa chay.

Vei baet ema: atya behekkesha midderabbi yona. deamar rabbi yona, veittema rav huna bereh derav yehoshua, amar kera: "ki kol asher yaase mikkol hattoevot haelle venichretu", hukeshu kol haarayot kullan leeshet ach: ma eshet ach — sharya, af kol arayot — name sharyayn, ketav rachamana "aleha".
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: mikkedi kol arayot, ikka leakkoshinhu leeshet ach, veikka leakkoshinhu laachot ishsha. may chazet deakkesht laachot ishsha? akkeshinhu leeshet ach!
Ibbaet ema: lekulla vechumera — lechumera makkeshinan. ibbaet ema: hacha tere issure, vehacha tere issure — utere mittere yalfinan. aval hacha chada issura — utere mechada la yalfinan.
Rava amar: erva la tzericha kera, deen ase doche lo taase sheyyesh bo karet. ki itzterich kera lemesar tzara.
Veerva la tzericha kera? veha tanya: en li ella hi!
Mishshum tzaratah.
Veha katane: en li ella hen! mishshum tzarotehen.
Ta shema, rabbi omer: "velakach" "ulekachah", "veyibbem" "veyibbemah" — leesor tzarot vaarayot.
Ema: leesor tzarot shel arayot. veha tere kerae kanasev leh, may lav: chad leerva vechad letzara?
La, idi veidi letzara: chad lemesar tzara bimkom mitzva, vechad lemishre tzara shello bimkom mitzva.
May tama — "veyibbem" "veyibbemah": bimkom yibbum hu daasira tzara, shello bimkom yibbum — sharya tzara.
Amar rav ashe: matnitin name dayka, dekatane: chamesh esre nashim potrot tzarotehen. veillu "peturot ufotrot" la katane. shema minna.
Umay shena erva dela tzericha kera — deen ase doche lo taase sheyyesh bo karet? tzara name la tibbee kera — mishshum deen ase doche lo taase sheyyesh bo karet!
Amar leh rav acha bar bivi mar leravina: hachi kaamrinan mishshemeh derava: tzara name la itzterich kera. ki itzterich kera
b: Lemishre tzara shello bimkom mitzva. may tama — amar kara "aleha": bimkom "aleha" hu daasira, shello bimkom aleha — sharya.
Amar leh rame bar chama lerava: ema erva gufeh shello bimkom mitzva tishtere! velav kal vachomer hu? bimkom mitzva asira — shello bimkom mitzva sharya?!
Amar leh: tzara tochiach, devimkom mitzva asira veshello bimkom mitzva sharya! amar leh: alecha amar kera "bechayyeha" — kol shebbechayyeha.
Hay "bechayyeha" mibbee leh lemaote leachar mita! hahi mivishsha el achotah" nafka.
I mivishsha el achotah", hava amena: nitgarsha — sharya, talmud lomar: "bechayyeha" — kol shebbechayyeha, deaf al gav denitgarsha lo!

Ella amar rav huna bar tachlifa mishshemeh derava: tere kerae ketivi. ketiv: "ishsha el achotah lo tikkach litzror", uchetiv: "legallot ervatah", dachada mashma. ha ketzad? bimkom mitzva — shetehen asurot, shello bimkom mitzva — hi asura vetzaratah mutteret.
Efoch ana: bimkom mitzva — hi asura vetzaratah mutteret, veshello bimkom mitzva — shetehen asurot. im ken, lo yeamer "aleha".

Amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana: mimmay dehay "aleha" leissura, dilma lehettera, vehachi kaamar rachamana: "ishsha el achotah lo tikkach litzror", lo hi velo tzaratah — shello bimkom "aleha", aval bimkom "aleha" — shetehen muttarot.
Im ken, "legallot erva" dachada hechi mashkachat la? i bimkom mitzva — shetehen muttarot, i shello bimkom mitzva — shetehen asurot?!
Gufa. rabbi omer: "velakach" "ulekachah", "veyibbem" "veyibbemah", leesor tzarot vaarayot. mide "tzarot" ketiva hacha? veod: tzarot millitzror" nafka!
"Litzror" mappek leh rabbi lechidrabbi shimon.
Tzara hacha ketiv? hachi kaamar: im ken, lema kera "velakach", may "ulekachah" — kol hecha deikka tere likkuchin, dei bae nasev hay vei bae nasev hay — sharya. vei la — tarvayyhu asirin.
"Veyibbemah" — bimkom yibbum hu daasira tzara, shello bimkom yibbum — sharya tzara. verabbanan, hay "ulekachah" — may avdi leh?
Mibbee lehu lechidrabbi yose bar chanina. deamar rabbi yose bar chanina: "ulekachah" — melammed shemmegarsha beget umachzirah. "veyibbemah" — al korchah.
Verabbi? derabbi yose bar chanina — milleishsha" nafka, al korchah — miyyevama yavo aleha" nafka.
Verabbi, hay "aleha" may aved leh? mibbee leh lechidtanya: en chayyayvin bet din ella al davar shezzedono karet veshiggato chattat. vechen hammashiach.

a: Velo baavoda zara, ella al davar shechayyayvin al zedono karet veshiggato chattat. utenan name: kol mitzva shebbattora shechayyayvin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat, yachid — mevi kisba o seira, nasi — mevi sair, mashiach uvet din — meviin par.
Uvaavoda zara, yachid nasi umashiach — meviin seira, tzibbur — meviim par vesair, par leola vesair lechattat. mena hane mille?

Detanu rabbanan: "venoda hachattat asher chatu aleha", rabbi omer: neemar kan "aleha", veneemar lehallan "aleha". ma lehallan davar shechayyayvim al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat, af kan davar shechayyayvin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat.
Ashkechan tzibbur, mashiach menalan? dichtiv bemashiach: "leashmat haam", hare mashiach ketzibbur.
Yachid venasi — atya "mitzvot" "mitzvot".
Velo baavoda zara ella al davar shechayyayvin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat. tzibbur baavoda zara yalef meene" "meene".
Yachid, nasi umashiach mivveim nefesh achat" — echad yachid veechad nasi veechad mashiach bammashma. vav mosif al inyan rishon,
Veyilmad tachton min haelyon.
Verabbanan, hay sevara mena lehu? nafka lehu, middemakre leh rabbi yehoshua livreh: "tora achat yihye lachem laose bishgaga", "vehannefesh asher taase beyad rama" —
Hukkesha kol hattora kullah laavoda zara: ma avoda zara — davar shechayyayvin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat, af kol davar shechayyayvin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat.
Ashkechan yachid venasi umashiach, ben baavoda zara uven bishar mitzvot. tzibbur baavoda zara minnayin? amar kera: "veim nefesh", veyilmad elyon mittachton.
Ella, tzibbur bishar mitzvot menalan? yalef "meene" "meene". verabbi, hay "tora achat" may aved leh? mibbee leh lechidtanya: lefi shemmatzinu shechillek hakkatuv ben yechidim limrubbim,
Yechidim biskila — lefichach mamonan palet, merubbin besayif — lefichach mamonan aved.
Yachol nachlok bekorbenotehen — talmud lomar: "tora achat yihye lachem".
Matkef la rav chilkiyya mehageronya: tama dichtav rachamana "tora achat yihye lachem", ha lav hachi, hava amena nachlok. may layyto? layyto par — tzibbur bishar mitzvot hu demayytu.
Kisba — yachid bishar mitzvot hu demayyte, seir — nasi bishar mitzvot hu demayyte. par leola vesair lechattat — tzibbur baavoda zara hu demayytu, veella may, seira — yachid name hayeynu korbano!
Itzterich, salka datach amena: hoil vetzibbur behoraa mayytu par leola vesair lechattat, inhu name nayto ippecha.
I name, tzarich veen lo takkana ka mashma lan.
Amar leh levi lerabbi: may irya detane chamesh esre? litne shesh esre! amar leh: kimdumme li sheen lo moach bekodkodo.
May datach, immo anusat aviv?
Immo anusat aviv — pelugeta derabbi yehuda verabbanan hi, uviflugeta la ka mayyre.
Vela? vahare issur mitzva veissur kedushsha,
Difligi rabbi akiva verabbanan — vekatane!
Befirkin ka amrinan. veha bet shammay mattirin et hatztzarot laachin, uvet hillel osrin!
Bet shammay bimkom bet hillel enah mishna. vahare eshet achiv shello haya beolamo,
b: Difligi rabbi shimon verabbanan, vekatane!
Benolad ulevassof yibbem — la pelig rabbi shimon.
Vehaamar rabbi oshaya: chaluk haya rabbi shimon af barishona!
Ha ittotav rabbi oshaya.
Vehaamar rav yehuda amar rav, vechen tane rabbi chiyyay: bechullan ani kore bahen haasura laze — mutteret laze, vehaasura laze — mutteret laze, vaachotah shehi yevimtah choletzet o mityaybemet.
Verav yehuda metargem mechamoto veelach. aval shitta bave deresha — la. may tama?
Kevan devitto
Beunesin mashkachat, benissuin la mashkachat la. benissuin kamayyre, beunesin la ka mayyre.
Veabbaye metargem af bitto meanusato — kevan deashkoche mashkachat la, i baaya min haunesin tihve, [i baaya min hannissuin tihve]. aval eshet achiv shello haya beolamo — la. may tama?
Kevan dilrabbi shimon hu demashkachat la, lerabbanan la mashkachat la — biflugeta la ka mayyre.
Verav safra metargem af eshet achiv shello haya beolamo, umashkachat la beshitta achim, veallibba derabbi shimon.

a: Vesimanaych: met, nolad, veyibbem. met, nolad, veyibbem.

Ella lerabbi hane kelale let leh. rav adda karchina kammeh derav kahana amar mishshemeh derava: leolam it leh lerabbi hane kelale, vehachi kaamar leh: immo anusat aviv — bachada mashkachat la, betarte la kamashkachat la.
I yaakov shete achayot anas, achotah shehi yevimtah — mashkachat la, haasura laze mutteret laze — la mashkachat.
Vei shete nochriyyot anas, haasura laze mutteret laze — mashkachat la, achotah shehi yevimtah — la mashkachat la.
Rav ashe amar: leolam let leh lerabbi hane kelale, uviflugeta kamayyre, umay "kimdumme ani sheen lo moach bekodkodo" dekaamar leh —
Hachi kaamar leh: may tama la dayykat matnitin? dematnitin rabbi yehuda hi [deasar baanusat aviv].
Dekatane: shesh arayot chamurot meellu, mippene shehen nesuot laacherim tzarotehen muttarot: immo, veeshet aviv, vaachot aviv. may immo? illema nesuat aviv — hayeynu eshet aviv!
Ella lav — anusat aviv. vekatane: mippene shehen nesuot laacherim: laacherim in, laachin la. man shamat leh deit leh hay sevara — rabbi yehuda, deasar baanusat aviv. mishshum hachi la tane leh.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: lerabbi yehuda name mashkachat la — dei avar unesev? "dei" la katane.
Amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana, bela "dei" name mashkachat la: yaakov anas kallato veholid mimmenna ben, umet [reuven] belo banim. unefala la kamme bera, umiggo deihi asira — tzaratah name asira.
Amar leh: beachvata dehettera kamayyre, beachvata deissura la kamayyre. veaf al pi chen, badka levi bematniteh.
Detane levi: immo, peamim poteret tzaratah, ufeamim enah poteret tzaratah. ketzad? hayta immo nesuat aviv, venisset leachiv meaviv, umet — zo hi immo sheen poteret tzaratah.
b: Hayta immo anusat aviv, venisset leachiv meaviv, umet — zo hi immo sheppoteret tzaratah.

Veaf al pi sheshshanu chachamim bemishnatenu "chamesh esre", yesh lanu lehosif shesh esre kegon zo. amar leh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan: lelevi daamar "dei" name katane — litne: hacholetz livimto vechazar vekiddeshah, umet belo banim, demiggo deihi asura — tzaratah name asira!
Amar leh: lefi sheenah betzarat tzara.
Velema leh: chayyayve lavin hi, vechayyayve lavin bene chalitza veyibbum ninhu.
Lidvarav kaamar leh: ledidi — chayyayve lavin hem, vechayyayve lavin bene chalitza veyibbum ninhu. ella ledidach — chayyayve karetot ninhu. lefi sheenan betzarat tzara.
Ittemar: hacholetz livimto vechazar vekiddeshah, amar resh lakish: hu — en chayyayv al hachalutza karet,
Vehaachin — chayyayvin al hachalutza karet. al hatztzara, ben hu uven haachim — chayyayvin al hatztzara karet.
Verabbi yochanan amar: ben hu uven haachin enan chayyayvin lo al hachalutza karet, velo al hatztzara karet. may tama deresh lakish? amar kera: "asher lo yivne", kevan shello bana — shuv lo yivne.
Ihu hu dekae belo yivne", aval echav — kidkayymi kayymi.
Vaale dida, hu dekae belo yivne", ha tzara — kidkayyma kayyma.
Verabbi yochanan: mi ikka midde demeikkara i bae hay — chaletz, vei bae hay — chaletz, vei bae — lehay chaletz, vei bae — lehay chaletz, vehasheta kae ala becharet?
Ella, ihu shelichuta deachim kaaved, ihi shelichuta detzara kaavda.

Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: hacholetz livimto, vechazar vekiddeshah, umet — tzericha chalitza min haachin. bishlama ledidi, deamena chayyayve lavin ninhu, hayeynu ditzricha chalitza min haachin.
Ella ledidach, ammay tzericha chalitza?
Uletamaych, ema sefa: amad echad min haachin vekiddeshah, en lah alav kelum. vei chayyayve lavin ninhu, ammay en lah alav kelum?
Amar rav sheshet: sefa atan lerabbi akiva, deamar: en kiddushin tofsin bechayyayve lavin. velitne: ledivre rabbi akiva en lo alav kelum!

a: Kashya. rav ashe savar la keresh lakish, umetaretz la kerabbi shimon. ravina savar la kerabbi yochanan, umetaretz kerabbanan.
Rav ashe savar la keresh lakish umetaretz la kerabbi shimon: hacholetz livimto vechazar vekiddeshah — tzericha chalitza min haachin. man achin —
Achin hayyillodim. keman — kerabbi shimon.
Amad echad min hannoladim vekiddeshah — en lah alav kelum, keman — keresh lakish.
Ravina savar la kerabbi yochanan, umetaretz la allibba derabbanan: hacholetz livimto vechazar vekiddeshah — tzericha chalitza min haachin. man achin — achin hannoladim, keman — kerabbi yochanan.
Amad echad min hayyillodim vekiddeshah — en lah alav kelum, keman — kerabbanan.
Ittemar: habba al yevama, uva echad min haachin al tzaratah, peligi ba rav acha veravina. chad amar: becharet. vechad amar: baase.
Man deamar becharet — keresh lakish, uman deamar baase — kerabbi yochanan.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: tzarat sota asura.
Tumea ketiv bah, kaarayot.
Metiv rav chisda, rabbi shimon omer: biatah o chalitzatah meachiv shel rishon — poteret tzaratah.
[Amar lecha rav:] amena lach ana sota deorayyta, veat amrat li sota derabbanan?!
Udekaare la may kaare la? kasavar kol detakkun rabbanan — keen deorayyta takkun.
Metiv rav ashe: nichnesa immo leseter, veshahata immo kede tumea — asura levetah, vaasura leechol bitruma. veim met, choletzet
b: Velo mityaybemet. [amar lecha rav:] amena lach ana sota vadday, veamrat li at sota safek! umay shena sota vadday (may tama) — mishshum dichtiv bah tumea,

Sota safek name tumea ketiva ba! detanya: rabbi yose ben kippar omer mishshum rabbi elazar: hammachzir gerushato min hannissuin — asura, min haerusin — mutteret, mishshum shenneemar: "achare asher huttammaa".
Vachachamim omrim: achat zo veachat zo — asura, ella ma ani mekayyem "achare [asher] huttammaa" — lerabbot sota shennistera.
Umay "nistera" — nivala. veammay kare leh nistera — lishshana mealleya naket. nivala, tumea behedya ketiv ba, "venistera vehi nitmaa"?
Lemekam ala belav. verabbi yose ben kippar — lav besota let leh, vaafillu zannay name.
May tama — havaya veishut ketiv ba.

Bea minneh rav yehuda merav sheshet: hammachzir gerushato mishshennisset, umet, tzaratah mahu? allibba derabbi yose ben kippar la tibbee lach, kevan deamar rabbi yose ben kippar tumea bemachazir gerushato hu dichtiva — tzaratah kemotah.
Vei mishshum dichtiv bah "toeva hi", hi toeva veen baneha toavin — ha tzaratah toeva.
Ki tibbee lach allibba derabbanan: af al gav daamur rabbanan tumea besota hu dichtiv — en mikra yotze mide peshuto,
O dilma kevan deiakar — iakar. ikka deamri: allibba derabbanan la tibbee lach, kevan deitakar — iakar.

Ki tibbee lach — allibba derabbi yose ben kippar, may? af al gav deamar rabbi yose ben kippar tumea bemachazir gerushato hu dichtiva — miet rachamana hi toeva veen tzaratah toeva, o dilma: hi toeva veen baneha toavin, ha tzaratah — toeva?
Amar leh, tenetuha: hayta achat keshera veachat pesula, im haya choletz — choletz lappesula, veim haya meyaybem — meyaybem lakkeshera.
May "keshera" umay "pesula"? illema "keshera" — keshera lealma, "pesula" — pesula lealma. kevan dildideh chazya — may nafka leh minna?
Ella lav: "keshera" — keshera leh, "pesula" — pesula leh, umay nihu — machazir gerushato, vekatane: veim haya meyaybem — meyaybem lakkeshera!
La, leolam "keshera" — keshera lealma, "pesula" — pesula lealma. udekaamrat: kevan dildideh chazya, may nafka leh minna — mishshum derav yosef.
Deamar rav yosef: kan shana rabbi: lo yishpoch adam me voro, vaacherim tzerichim lahem.
Ta shema: hammachzir gerushato mishshennisset — hi vetzaratah choletzet. hi vetzaratah salka datach? [ella] ema: o hi, o tzaratah.
Velav tarotze kamtartzat la?! taretz hachi: hi — choletzet, tzaratah — o choletzet o mityaybemet.
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba, rabbi yochanan bae: hammachzir gerushato mishshennisset, tzaratah mahu? amar leh rabbi amme: vetibbee lach hi gufa? hi gufa la kamibbaya li,
Deamrinan kal vachomer: bammuttar lah — asura, baasur lah — lo kol shekken?! ki ka mibbaya li: tzaratah, may? mi allim kal vachomer lemidche tzara, o la?

Rav nachman bar yitzchak matne hachi: amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba, bae rabbi yochanan: hammachzir gerushato mishshennisset, mahu? amar leh rabbi amme: vetibbee lach tzaratah? tzaratah la kamibbaya li, dela allim kal vachomer lemidche tzara. ella ki kamibbaya li, hi gufa may: mi allim kal vachomer bimkom mitzva, o la?

a: Amar leh, tenetuha: hayta achat keshera veachat pesula, im haya choletz — choletz lappesula, veim haya meyaybem — meyaybem lakkeshera. may "keshera" umay "pesula"? illema "keshera" — keshera lealma, "pesula" — pesula lealma, kevan dildideh chazya — may nafka leh minna?
Ella lav: "keshera" — keshera leh, "pesula" — pesula leh. umay nihu — machazir gerushato. vekatane: im haya meyaybem — meyaybem lakkeshera.
La: keshera lealma, pesula lealma. udekaamrat, kevan dildideh chazya, may nafka leh minna — mishshum derav yosef. deamar rav yosef: kan shana rabbi lo yishpoch adam me voro vaacherim tzerichim lahem.

Ta shema: hammachzir gerushato mishshennisset — hi vetzaratah choletzet. hi vetzaratah salka datach? ella ema: o hi o tzaratah! velav tarotze ka metartzat la? taretz hachi: hi — choletzet, tzaratah — o choletzet o mityaybemet.
Amar rav lele bar memel, amar mar ukeva, amar shemuel: tzarat memaenet asura. leman? ilema laachim: hasheta hi gufa sharya, deamar shemuel: meana baze mutteret baze — tzaratah mibbaya?
Ella ledideh, umay shena memaenet desharya leachin — dela avda behu maase? tzara name la avda behu maase!
Gezera mishshum tzarat bitto memaenet. vetzarat bitto memaenet mi asira? vehatnan: vechullan im metu o meanu — tzarotehen muttarot!
Demeana beman? ilema demeana bevaal, hayeynu gerusha! ella lav — beyavam.
La: leolam bevaal, utere gavvne gerushin. umay shena ki meana bevaal — daakar[ti]ynhu lenissuin,
Ki meana beyavam name — nissuin kammae ka akra!
Mishshum detane rame bar yechezkel. detane rame bar yechezkel: meana babbaal — mutteret leaviv, bayyavam — asura leaviv.
Alma, mishsheat nefila niret kechallato.
Hacha name, mishsheat nefila niret ketzarat bitto.
Amar rav assi: tzarat aylonit asura, shenneemar: "vehaya habbechor asher teled" — perat laaylonit sheenah yoledet.
Metiv rav sheshet: shelosha achin nesuin shalosh nashim nochriyyot, umet echad mehem, veasa bah sheni maamar,
Umet — hare ellu choltzot velo mityaybmot, shenneemar: "umet echad mehem yevamah yavo aleha", mi shealeha zikat yavam echad, velo zikat shene yevamin.
Vekatane ala, amar rav yosef: zo hi tzarat eshet ach meav, sheissur nefila garam lah. shello matzinu bechol hattora kullah kegon zot.
"Zo hi" — lemaote may? lav lemaote tzarat aylonit, desharya?!
La, lemaote tzarat aylonit, daasira. umay "zo hi" — zo hi, deissur nefila garam lah — tzarata baaya chalitza, aylonit — afillu chalitza la baaya. may tama: ha deorayyta, ha derabbanan.
Tenan: vechullan im metu o meanu o nitgarshu o shennimtzeu aylonit — tzarotehen muttarot. la kashya: kan shehikkir bah,
Kan shello hikkir bah.
Dayka name, dekatane "shennimtzeu", vela katane "shehayu", shema minna. amar rava,
b: Hilcheta: tzarat aylonit mutteret, vaafillu hikkir bah. vaafillu tzarat bitto aylonit.
Veella ha dekatane "shennimtzeu" — teni "shehayu". ki ata ravin, amar rabbi yochanan: achat tzarat memaenet, veachat tzarat aylonit, veachat tzarat machazir gerushato — kullan muttarot.

Tane rav bivi kammeh derav nachman, shalosh nashim meshammeshot bemoch: ketanna, meubberet, umenika. ketanna — shemma titabber veshemma tamut. meubberet — shemma taase ubbarah sandal. menika — shemma tigmol benah veyamut.

Veezo hi ketanna — mibbat achat esre shana veyom echad ad shetem esre shana veyom echad. pachot mikken veyater al ken — meshammeshet kedarkah veholechet, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: achat zo veachat zo meshammeshet kedarkah veholechet, umin hashshamayim yerachamu, mishshum shenneemar: "shomer petaim Adonai".
Middekaamar shemma titabber veshemma tamut, mikkelal deikka ketanna demiabbera vela meta. im ken, matzinu chamoto memaenet.
Utenan: i atta yachol lomar bachamoto veem chamoto veem chamiv shennimtzeu aylonit o shemmeanu! ema: shemma titabber vetamut.
Deamar rabba bar levay: gevul yesh lah, kodem hazzeman hazze — enah mitabberet kol ikkar, toch hazzeman hazze — hi meta veubbarah met, leachar zeman hazze — hi chayya veubbarah chay.

Ini? veha tane rabba bar shemuel: i atta yachol lomar bachamoto veem chamoto veem chamiv shennimtzeu aylonit o shemmeanu — shekkevar yaldu. ella leolam: shemma titabber veshemma tamut. veella kashya hach!
Amar rav safra: banim hare hem kesimanim. veit deamri: banim adifi missimanim. lemay nafka minna? daafillu lerabbi yehuda deamar ad sheyyirbe hashshachor, bevanim mode.

a: Verav zevid amar: en banim belo simanim. venivdok! chayyshinan shemma nashru. hanicha leman deamar choshshin.
Ella leman deamar en choshshin — may ikka lememar? afillu leman deamar en choshshin — mishshum tzaar leda chayyshinan.
Ketzad potrot tzarotehen vechulei. menahane mille? amar rav yehuda, deamar kera: "litzror" — hattora ribbeta tzarot harebe.
Rav ashe amar, sevara hi: tzara may tama asira — devimkom erva kayyma, tzarat tzara name — bimkom erva kayyma.
Ketzad im metu hen kulei. vaafillu kanas ulevassof gerash.

Ureminhu: shelosha achim, shenayim mehen nesuim shete achayot, veechad nasuy nochrit, gerash echad mibbaale achayot ishto, umet hannasuy nochrit uchenasah hamegaresh, vamet, zo hi sheamru: sheim metu o nitgarshu — tzarotehen muttarot.
Tama degerash veachar kach kanas, aval kanas veachar kach gerash — la!
Amar rabbi yirmeya: tavra, mi sheshshana zo lo shana zo. hay tanna savar — mita mappelet,
Vehay tanna savar — nissuin harishonim mappilim.
Rava amar: leolam chad tanna hu, vezo veen tzarich lomar zo katane.
Vechol sheyyechola lemaen. utemaen hasheta, vetityaybem! lema mesayyeya leh lerabbi oshaya.
Deamar rabbi oshaya: memaenet lemaamaro, veenah memaenet lezikkato.
La, tzarat erva shane. detane rame bar yechezkel: meana babbaal — mutteret leaviv. meana beyavam — asura leaviv.
Alma: mishsheat nefila niret kechallato. hacha name: mishsheat nefila niret ketzarat bitto.
Mishna shesh arayot chamurot meellu, mippene shennesuot laacherim — tzarotehen muttarot:
Immo, veeshet aviv, vaachot aviv, achoto meaviv, veeshet achi aviv, veeshet achiv meaviv.
Bet shammay mattirin hatztzarot laachim, uvet hillel osrim.
b: Chaltzu — bet shammay poslin min hakkehunna, uvet hillel machshirin. nityaybmu — bet shammay machshirin, uvet hillel poslin.

Af al pi sheellu osrim veellu mattirin, ellu poslin veellu machshirin — lo nimneu bet shammay millissa nashim mibbet hillel, vela bet hillel mibbet shammay. kol hatteharot vehattemaot shehayu ellu metaharim veellu metammein — lo nimneu osin teharot ellu al gabbe ellu.
Gemara amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi: may tama devet shammay, dichtiv: "lo tihye eshet hammet hachutza leish zar". "chutza" — mikkelal deikka penimit, veamar rachamana: "lo tihye".

Uvet hillel — mibbee lehu lechidrav yehuda amar rav. deamar rav yehuda amar rav: minnayin sheen kiddushin tofsin bivama — shenneemar: "lo tihye eshet hammet hachutza leish zar". lo tihye bah havaya lezar.
Uvet shammay — mi ketiv "lachutz"? "chutza" ketiv. uvet hillel — kevan dichtiv "chutza", keman dichtiv "lachutz" dame.

Detanya, rabbi nechemya omer: kol teva shetztzericha lamed bitchillatah — hetil lah hakkatuv he besofah. vetana deve rabbi yishmael: kegon "elim" — "elima", "machanayim" — "machanayma", "mitzrayim" — "mitzrayma", "divlatayma", "yerushalayma", "midbara".
Uvet shammay, derav yehuda amar rav mena lehu? milleish zar" nafka.
Uvet hillel name, tippok lehu milleish zar"? in hachi name. "chutza" lema li — lerabbot haarusa.
Veiddach: mechutza" — "hachutza". veiddach: "chutza" "hachutza" — la mashma lehu.
Rava amar: tamayyhu devet shammay deen issur chal al issur.
Tinach hecha denasa met, veachar kach nasa chay — la ate issur achot ishsha vechayel aissur eshet ach. ella nasa chay veachar kach nasa met, achot ishsha kadem!
Kevan dela ate issur eshet ach vechayel aissur achot ishsha, havya la tzarat erva shello bimkom mitzva, vesharya.
Chaltzu bet shammay poslim vechulei. peshita!
Leappoke derabbi yochanan ben nuri, deamar: bou unetakken lahem latztzarot sheyyehu choltzot velo mityaybmot. ka mashma lan devet hillel machshirim.
Nityaybmu, bet hillel poslin kulei. ha tu lema li! ayyeyde ditna chaltzu, tena name nityaybmu.
Tenan hatam: megilla nikret beachad asar, uvishnem asar, uvishlosha asar, uvearbaa asar, uvachamishsha asar, lo pachot velo yoter.
Amar leh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan: ikkeri kan "lo titgoddu", lo teasu aguddot aguddot? hay "lo titgoddu" mibbee leh legufeh, deamar rachamana: lo taasu chabbura al met!
Im ken, lema kera "lo tegoddu". may "titgoddu" — shema minna lehachi hu daata. veema kulleh lehachi hu daata! im ken, lema kera "lo tagoddu". may "lo titgoddu" — shema minna tarte.
Amar leh: ad kan lo shanita makom shennahagu laasot melacha bearve pesachim ad chatzot — osin, makom shennahagu shello laasot — en osin!
Amar leh: amena lach ana issura, deamar rav shemen bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: "lekayyem et yeme happurim bizmannehem" — zemannim harebe tikkenu lahem chachamim, veat amrat li minhaga?!
Vehatam lav issura huy? vehatnan: (ballayla) bet shammay osrin, uvet hillel mattirin.
Amar leh: hatam, haroe omer: melacha hu delet leh. veha bet shammay mattirin hatztzarot laachim, uvet hillel osrim?

a: Mi savrat asu bet shammay kedivrehem? lo asu bet shammay kedivrehem. verabbi yochanan amar: asu veasu. uviflugeta [derav ushemuel]. derav omer: lo asu bet shammay kedivrehem, ushemuel omer: asu veasu.
Emat? illema kodem bat kol — may tama deman deamar lo asu? veella leachar bat kol — may tama deman deamar asu?
I baet ema kodem bat kol, vei baet ema leachar bat kol. i baet ema kodem bat kol, uchegon devet hillel rubba, leman deamar lo asu — deha bet hillel rubba.
Uman deamar asu, ki azlinan batar rubba — hecha dechi hadade ninhu. hacha, bet shammay mechaddedi tefe.
Vei baet ema leachar bat kol, man deamar lo asu — deha nefaka bat kol, uman daamar asu — rabbi yehoshua hi, deamar: en mashgichin bevat kol.

Uman daamar asu, karenan kan "lo titgoddu" — lo teasu aguddot aguddot! amar abbaye: ki amrinan "lo titgoddu" — kegon shete batte dinim beir achat, hallalu morim kedivre bet shammay, vehallalu morim kedivre bet hillel. aval shete batte dinim bishte ayayrot — let lan ba.

Amar leh rava: veha bet shammay uvet hillel kishte batte dinim beir achat dame! ella amar rava: ki amrinan "lo titgoddu" — kegon bet din beir achat, pelag morin kedivre bet shammay, ufelag morin kedivre bet hillel. aval shete batte dinin beir achat — let lan ba.
Ta shema: bimkomo shel rabbi eliezer hayu kortim etzim laasot pechamim beshabbat laasot barzel. bimkomo shel rabbi yose haggelili hayu ochlim besar of bechalav.
Bimkomo shel rabbi eliezer — in, bimkomo shel rabbi akiva — la. detanya, kelal amar rabbi akiva: kol melacha sheefshar laasotah meerev shabbat — en docha et hashshabbat.
Vehay may teyuveta? mekomot mekomot shane! udekaare la — may kaare la?!
Salka datach amena mishshum chumera deshabbat — kemakom echad dame, ka mashma lan.
Ta shema, derabbi avahu ki ikkela leatreh derabbi yehoshua ben levi hava metaltel sheraga. vechi ikkela leatreh derabbi yochanan, la hava metaltel sheraga.
Vehay may kusheya? vela amrinan mekomot shane? anan hachi kaamrinan: rabbi avahu, hechi aved hacha hachi, vehechi aved hacha hachi?
Rabbi avahu kerabbi yehoshua ben levi sevira leh, vechi mikkela leatreh derabbi yochanan la hava metaltel mishshum kevodo derabbi yochanan. vehaikka shammaa! demoda leh leshammaa.

Ta shema: af al pi sheellu osrim veellu mattirim — lo nimneu bet shammay millissa nashim mibbet hillel, velo bet hillel mibbet shammay. i amrat bishlama lo asu, mishshum hachi lo nimneu. ella i amrat asu, ammay lo nimneu?
Bishlama bet shammay mibbet hillel lo nimneu, divne chayyayve lavin ninhu.
Ella bet hillel mibbet shammay ammay lo nimneu? bene chayyayve karetot — mamzerim ninhu?

Vechi tema kasavri bet hillel deen mamzer mechayyayve karetot — vehaamar rabbi elazar: af al pi shennechleku bet shammay uvet hillel betzarot, modim sheen mamzer ella mimmi sheissuro issur erva veanush karet! ella lav shema minna, lo asu!
La, leolam asu, demodi lehu ufarshi.
Vehachi name mistabbera, dekatane sefa: kol hatteharot vechol hattemaot shehayu ellu metaharin veellu metammein — lo nimneu osim teharot ellu al gabbe ellu.
b: I amrat bishlama demodi lehu — mishshum hachi lo nimneu, ella i amrat dela modi lehu, bishlama bet shammay mibbet hillel lo nimneu — ditmaot devet hillel, levet shammay teharot ninhu.
Ella bet hillel mibbet shammay lamma lo nimneu? teharot devet shammay, levet hillel temaot ninhu! ella lav demodi lehu, shema minna.
Umay ulemeh dehach mehach? mahu detema tzara kala it la, ka mashma lan.

Gufa, amar rabbi elazar: af al pi shennechleku bet shammay uvet hillel betzarot, modim sheen mamzer ella mimmi sheissuro issur erva veanush karet. man modim? illema bet shammay levet hillel — peshita! bene chayyayve lavin, kesherim ninhu!
Ella bet hillel levet shammay — hi gufa chayyayve karetot hi!
Leolam bet shammay levet hillel, uleappoke midderabbi akiva, deamar: yesh mamzer mechayyayve lavin, ka mashma lan deen mamzer mechayyayve lavin.
Ta shema: af al pi shennechleku bet shammay uvet hillel betzarot uvaachayot,
Beget yashan, uvisfek eshet ish, uvimgaresh et ishto velana immo befunedak,
Bechesef uveshave kesef, bifruta uveshave peruta —

Lo nimneu bet shammay millissa nashim mibbet hillel, velo bet hillel mibbet shammay. lelammedcha shechibba vereut nohagim ze baze, lekayyem ma shenneemar: "haemet vehashshalom ehavu". rabbi shimon omer: nimneu hen min havvadday, velo nimneu min hassafek.

I amrat bishlama asu — mishshum hachi nimneu. ella i amrat lo asu, ammay nimneu? vetisbera? nehi name deasu, bishlama bet hillel — nimneu mibbet shammay, dechayyayve karetot ninhu, umamzerim hem levet hillel.

Ella bet shammay — ammay nimneu mibbet hillel? bene chayyayve lavin ninhu, uchesherim ninhu! kidamar rav nachman bar yitzchak: lo nitzrecha ella latztzara atzmah, hacha name: la nitzrecha ella latztzara atzmah.
Umay shena min havvadday — deissura hu, safek name issura hu!
La tema: min hassafek, ella ema: min hassetam, demodi lehu ufarshi.
Umay ka mashma lan, deahava vereut nohagim ze baze? hayeynu resha! ha ka mashma lan dechulla rabbi shimon hi.

Ta shema deamar rabbi yochanan ben nuri: heach halacha zo rovachat beyisrael? naase kedivre bet shammay — havvalad mamzer ledivre bet hillel, naase kedivre bet hillel — havvalad pagum ledivre bet shammay. bou unetakken lahen latztzarot,

a: Sheyyehu choltzot velo mityaybmot. lo hispiku ligmor et haddavar ad shennitrefa hashshaa.
Amar leh rabban shimon ben gamliel: ma naase lahem latztzarot harishonot meatta?
I amrat bishlama asu — hayeynu dekaamar ma naase. ella i amrat lo asu, may ma naase?
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: lo nitzrecha ella letzara atzmah, "uma naase" hachi kaamar: hanach tzarot devet hillel, levet shammay hechi naaved lehu?
Lichletzu — mimmaasi aggavrayyhu. vechi tema limmaasan — "deracheha darche noam vechol netivoteha shalom".
Ta shema, deamar rabbi tarfon: teevani, matay tavo tzarat habbat leyadi veessaenna! ema veassienna.
Veha teevani kaamar! leappoke midderabbi yochanan ben nuri.
Ta shema: maase bevitto shel rabban gamliel shehayta nesua leabba achiv, umet belo banim, veyibbem rabban gamliel et tzaratah. vetisbera, rabban gamliel mittalmide bet shammay hu?
Ella shane bitto shel rabban gamliel, deaylonit havay. ha middekatane sefa: acherim omrim bitto shel rabban gamliel aylonit hayta, mikkelal detanna kamma savar lav aylonit hayta!
Hikkir bah velo hikkir bah, ikka benayyhu.
Veibbaet ema: kanas ulevassof gerash ikka benayyhu.
Ibbaet ema: yesh tenay bevia ikka benayyhu.
Metiv rav mesharsheya: maase berabbi akiva shellikket etrog beechad bishvat, venahag bo shene issurin.
Echad kedivre bet shammay, veechad kedivre bet hillel. shema minna asu!
Rabbi akiva gemareh istappak leh, vela yeda i bet hillel beechad bishvat amur, o bachamishsha asar bishvat amur.
Metiv mar zutera: maase veyalda kallato shel shammay hazzaken, ufichet et hammaaziva, vesikkech al gabbe mitta bishvil katan. shema minna asu! hatam, haroe omer leapposhe avir kaaved.

Metiv mar zutera: maase beshoket yehu shehayta birushalayim, vehayta nekuva lammikve, vechol teharot shehayu birushalayim naasim al gabbah. veshalchu bet shammay vehirchivuha, shebbet shammay omrim: ad shettippachet berubbah,
Utenan: eruv mikvaot, kishfoferet hannod beovyay uvachalalah, kishte etzbaot chozrot limkoman. shema minna asu! hatam
b: Haroe omer: leapposhe mayya hu deka aved.

Ta shema, deamar rabbi elazar bar tzadok: keshehayiti lomed tora etzel rabbi yochanan hachorani, raiti shehaya ochel pat chareva bemelach bishne vatztzoret. bati vehodati et abba, amar li: holech lo zetim, veholachti lo. raa otan shehen lachin, amar li: en ani ochel zetim.
Bati vehodati et abba. amar li: lech veemor lo, chavit nekuva hayta ella shessetamuha shemarim. utenan: chavit shel zetim megulegalim, bet shammay omrim: en tzericha linnakev.
Uvet hillel omrim: tzericha linnakev. umodim sheim nikkeva usetamuha shemarim — shehi tehora.
Veaf al pi shettalmid shammay haya, kol maasav lo asa ella kedivre bet hillel. i amrat bishlama asu — hayeynu revuteh. ella i amrat lo asu — may revuteh?!

Ta shema: shaalu et rabbi yehoshua, tzarat habbat mahu? amar lahem: machloket bet shammay uvet hillel. vahalacha kedivre mi? amar lahem: mippene ma attem machnisin roshi ben shene harim gedolim, ben shete machlokot gedolot, ben bet shammay uven bet hillel. mityayre ani shemma yarotztzu gulgolti.

Aval ani meid lachem al shete mishpachot gedolot shehayu birushalayim, mishpachat bet tzevoim mibben achmay, umishpachat bet kofay mibben mekoshesh, shehem bene tzarot, umehem kohanim gedolim, veshimmeshu al gabbe hammizbeach.
I amrat bishlama asu — hayeynu dekaamar mityayre ani. ella i amrat lo asu, ammay kaamar mityayre ani? unehi name deasu, may mityayre ani?
Ha amar rabbi yehoshua: en mamzer ella mechayyayve mitot bet din! nehi name demamzer la have, pagum miha have.
Mikkal vachomer mealmana: ma almana, sheen issurah noheg bakkol — benah pagum, zo, sheissurah shave bakkol kulei.
Kavu minneh tzarot, vekafashet leh bene tzarot! tarte ka bae minneh: tzarot may? veim timtze lomar tzarot kevet hillel, bene tzarot devet hillel — levet shammay mahu?
Lemay nafka minna? lemifshat velad machazir gerushato levet hillel.
Mi kaamrinan kal vachomer: uma almana lechohen gadol sheen issurah shave bakkol — benah pagum. zo, sheissurah shave bakkol — eno din shebbenah pagum?
O dilma ikka lemifrach: ma lealmana shehi atzmah mitchallelet. vaamar lehu: tzarot mityayre ani,

a: Bene tzarot ani meid lachem.
Ta shema: bime rabbi dosa ben harekinas huttera tzarat habbat laachin. shema minna asu: shema minna.
Gufa. bime rabbi dosa ben harekinas hittiru tzarat habbat laachin, vehaya haddavar kashe lachachamim, mippene shechacham gadol haya, veenav kamu millavo levet hammidrash.

Amru: umi yelech veyodio? amar lahen rabbi yehoshua: ani elech. veacharav mi — rabbi elazar ben azarya. veacharav mi — rabbi akiva. halchu veamdu al petach beto. nichnesa shifchato, amra lo: rabbi, chachme yisrael bain etzlecha, amar lah: yikkansu, venichnesu.
Tefaso lerabbi yehoshua, vehoshivahu al mitta shel zahav. amar lo: rabbi, emor letalmidcha acher veyeshev. amar lo: mi hu? rabbi elazar ben azarya. amar: veyesh lo ben laazarya chaverenu?

Kara alav hammikra hazze: "naar hayiti gam zakanti velo raiti tzaddik neezav vezaro mevakkesh lachem". tefaso vehoshivo al mitta shel zahav. amar lo: rabbi, emor letalmidcha acher veyeshev. amar lo: umi hu? akiva ben yosef. amar lo: atta hu akiva ben yosef sheshshimcha holech missof haolam vead sofo?! shev beni, shev, kemotcha yirbu beyisrael.

Hitchilu mesabbevim oto bahalachot, ad shehiggiu letzarat habbat. amaru lo: tzarat habbat mahu? amar lahen: machloket bet shammay uvet hillel. halacha kedivre mi? amar lahen: halacha kevet hillel. amru lo: vahalo mishshimcha amru halacha kevet shammay!
Amar lahem: dosa shematem, o ben harekinas shematem? amaru lo: chayye rabbi, setam shamanu. amar lahem: ach katan yesh li, bechor satan hu, veyonatan shemo, vehu mittalmide shammay.

Vehizzaharu shello yekappeach etchem bahalachot, lefi sheyyesh immo shelosh meot teshuvot betzarat habbat shehi mutteret. aval meid ani alay shamayim vaaretz, sheal medocha zo yashav chaggay hannavi, veamar shelosha devarim: tzarat habbat asura,
Ammon umoav measserin masar ani bashsheviit, umekabbelim gerim min hakkardoyin umin hattarmodim.
Tanna: keshennichnesu — nichnesu befetach echad, kesheyyatzu — yatzu bishlosha petachim. paga bo berabbi akiva, akshi leh veokmeh.
Amar lo: atta hu akiva sheshshimcha holech missof haolam vead sofo? ashrecha shezzachita leshem, vaadayin lo higgata leroe vakar. amar lo rabbi akiva: vaafillu leroe tzon.
Ammon umoav measserin masar ani bashsheviit. deamar mar: harebe kerakkim kavshu ole mitzrayim velo kavshu ole vavel, ukedushsha rishona — kiddesha lishatah, velo kiddesha leatid lavo.
Vehinnichum, kede sheyyismechu alehen aniyyim bashsheviit.
Umekabbelim gerim min hakkardoyim vehattarmodim. ini?! veha tane rame bar yechezkel: en mekabbelim gerim min hakkardoyim! amar rav ashe: kartoyim ittemar. kidamri inashe: kartoyim pesulim.

Veikka deamri, tane rame bar yechezkel: en mekabbelim gerim min hakkartoyim. may lav: hayeynu kartoyim hayeynu kardoyim! amar rav ashe: la, kartoye lechod vekardoye lechod, kidamri inashe: kartoye pesili.
Rabbi yochanan vesavayya deamri tarvayyhu: en mekabbelim gerim min hattarmodim. umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? vehatnan: kol hakketamim habbaim min harkam — tehorim.
Verabbi yehuda metamme, mippene shehem gerim vetoim. mibben haggoyim — tehorim. vehavenan ba:
b: Kafasek vetane: mibben haggoyim, vaafillu min tarmod. veamar rabbi yochanan: zot omeret mekabbelin gerim mittarmod.
Vechi tema "zot", vela sevira leh — veha amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kistam mishna! amorae ninhu, veallibba derabbi yochanan.
Mittarmod may tama la? peligi ba rabbi yochanan vesavayya, chad amar: mishshum avde shelomo, vechad amar: mishshum benot yerushalayim.

Bishlama leman deamar mishshum avde shelomo, kasavar: goy veeved habba al bat yisrael — havvalad mamzer. ella leman deamar mishshum benot yerushalayim, may hi? peligi ba rav yosef verabbanan, vetarvayyhu mishshemeh derabba bar bar chana.

Chad amar: teresar alfe gavre veshitta alfe kashtoye, vechad amar: teresar alfe gavre, uminnayyhu shitta alfe kashtoye, beshaa shennichnesu goyim lahechol, hakkol nifnu al kesef vezahav, vehem nifnu al benot yerushalayim, shenneemar: "nashim betziyyon innu betulot beare yehuda".

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan, pasuk ze sar haolam amaro: "naar hayiti gam zakanti". man amreh? illema kudesha berich hu — mi ikka zikna kammeh? veella david amreh — mi kashshish kulle hay? ella shema minna sar haolam amaro.

Veamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan, may dichtiv: "yado paras tzar al kol machamaddeha" — ze ammon umoav. beshaa shennichnesu goyim lahechol, hakkol nifnu al kesef vezahav, vehem nifnu al sifre tora, amru: ze shekkatuv bo "lo yavo ammoni umoavi bikhal Adonai" — yissaref baesh!
"Tzivva Adonai leyaakov sevivav tzarav", amar rav: kegon humanya lefum nahara.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav assi: goy shekkiddesh bizman hazze — choshshin lekiddushin, shemma measeret hashshevatim hu. veha kol defaresh — merubba paresh!
Beducheta dikvii. deamar rabbi abba bar kahana: "vayyanchem bachlach uvechavor nehar gozan veare maday", chalach — ze chillazon, vechavor —

a: Zo chadyayv, "nehar gozan" — zo ginzak, "veare maday" — zo chamdan vechavroteha, veamri la: zo nihar vechavroteha. chavroteha man? amar shemuel: kerach, musheke, chidke vedumeke. amar rabbi yochanan: vechullan lifsul.
Ki amrita kammeh dishmuel, amar li: bincha habba min yisreelit karuy bincha, veen bincha habba min haggoya karuy bincha, ella benah.
Vehaikka banot, veamar ravina: shema minna, ben bittecha habba min haggoy karuy bincha! gemiri divnata dehahu dara itzteroye itztero.
Ikka deamri: ki amrita kammeh dishmuel, amar li: lo zazu mishsham, ad sheasaum goyim gemurim, shenneemar: "baAdonai bagadu ki vanim zarim yaladu".

Yatev rav yosef achoreh derav kahana, veyatev rav kahana kammeh derav yehuda veyatev vekaamar: atidin yisrael deavdi yoma tava ki charva tarmod. veha chariv! hahi tamod havay. rav ashe amar: hayeynu tarmod hayeynu tamod, ikkefole hu demikkafla[1]: chariv mehay gisa — ittiv mehay gisa, (vei) chariv mehay gisa — ittiv mehay gisa.

Yatev rav hamenuna kammeh deulla veka have bishmata, amar: ma gavra uma gavra! i lav deharpanya mateh! ikkesif, amar leh: kesaf gulgulta, lehecha yahavat? amar leh lefum nahara. amar leh: im ken, mippum nahara at.

May harepanya? amar rabbi zera: har shehakkol ponin bo. bematnita tana: kol sheen makkir mishpachto veshivto nifne lesham. amar rava: vehi amukka mishsheol, shenneemar: "miyyad sheol efdem mimmavet egalem", veillu pesul didhu let lehu takkanta.
Pesule deharpanya mishshum pesule demeshon, ufesule demeshon mishshum pesule detarmod, pesule detarmod mishshum avde shelomo.
Vehayeynu deamri inashe: kabba rabba vekabba zuta, miggandar veazel lishol, umishsheol letarmod, umittarmod lemeshan, umimmeshan leharepanya.
Hadaran alach chamesh esre nashim

Ketzad eshet achiv shello haya beolamo? shene achim, umet echad mehen, venolad lahen ach, veachar kach yibbem hashsheni et eshet achiv, umet. harishona yotza mishshum eshet achiv shello haya beolamo, vehashsheniyya mishshum tzaratah.
Asa bah maamar umet, sheniyya — choletzet velo mityaybemet.
Gemara amar rav nachman: man detane rishona la mishtabbash, man detane sheniyya la mishtabbash. man detane
b: Rishona la mishtabbash: may rishona — rishona linfila, uman detane sheniyya la mishtabbash: may sheniyya — sheniyya lenissuin. mi la askinan deyibbem veachar kach kanas? ella may sheniyya — sheniyya benissuin.

Eshet achiv shello haya beolamo hecha ketiva? amar rav yehuda amar rav, amar kera: "ki yeshvu achim yachdav", shehayta lahem yeshiva achat baolam, perat leeshet achiv shello haya beolamo. "yachdav" — meyuchadim bannachala, perat leachiv min haem.
Rabba amar: achin min haav yalef "achva" "achva" mibbene yaakov: ma lehallan — min haav velo min haem, af kan — min haav velo min haem.
Velelaf "achva" "achva" mearayot! danin "achim" meachim", veen danin "achim" meachicha".

May nafka minna, ha tana deve rabbi yishmael: "veshav hakkohen", "uva hakkohen", zo hi shiva zo hi bia! hane mille hecha delekka midde dedame leh, aval hecha deikka midde dedame leh — middedame leh yalfinan.

Velelaf "achva" "achva" millot, dichtiv: "ki anashim achim anachnu"! mistabbera mibbene yaakov hava leh lemelaf, mishshum demafne: middahava leh lemichtav "shenem asar avadecha bene avinu", uchetiv "achim" — shema minna leafnoye.

Veitzterich lemichtav "achim", veitzterich lemichtav "yachdav". dei ketav rachamana "achim", hava amena: lelaf "achva" "achva" millot, vechi tema la mafne — laye, afnoye mafne, middahava leh lemichtav "reim", uchetiv "achim", shema minna leafnoye — ketav rachamana: "yachdav", hameyuchadim bannachala.
Vei ketav rachamana "yachdav" — hava amena dimyaychadi beabba uveimma, tzericha.

Veha mehecha tete? yibbum bannachala tela rachmana, venachala min haav velo min haem hi! itzterich, salka datach amena: hoil vechiddush hu dekamishtere erva gabbeh, ema ad dimyaychadi beabba uveimma, tzericha.
Amar rav huna amar rav: shomeret yavam shemmeta — muttar beimmah, alma kasavar en zika. velema: halacha kedivre haomer en zika!
I hava amar hachi, hava amena: hane mille bitre, aval bechad — yesh zika.
Velema: halacha kedivre haomer en zika afillu bechad! i amar hachi, hava amena: afillu mechayyim — kamashma lan leachar mita in, mechayyim la — mishshum deasur levattel mitzvat yevamin.
Tenan: yevimto shemmeta — muttar baachotah. baachotah in, beimmah la.
Hu haddin daafillu beimmah, veayyeyde ditna resha: ishto shemmeta — muttar baachotah, baachotah in, aval beimmah la, dehavya la issura deorayyta — tena name sefa muttar baachotah.
Verav yehuda amar: shomeret yavam shemmeta — asur beimmah. alma kasavar yesh zika. velema: halacha kedivre haomer yesh zika!
I hava amar hachi, hava amena: hane mille bechad, aval bitre — en zika. veha ki peligi — bitre peligi? ella: i amar hachi,

a: Hava amena mechayyim, aval leachar mita — paka la zika, ka mashma lan dezika bichdi la paka. lema mesayyay leh: yevimto shemmeta — muttar baachotah. baachotah in, beimmah la!
Hu haddin daafillu beimmah, veayyeyde ditna resha: ishto shemmeta — muttar baachotah, davka baachotah, aval beimmah la, dehavya la issura deorayyta — tena name sefa muttar baachotah.

Metiv rav huna bar chiyyay: asa bah maamar umet — sheniyya choletzet velo mityaybemet. tama daavad ba maamar, ha la avad ba maamar — sheniyya name yabbome meyaybma, vei amrat yesh zika, havya la tzarat eshet achiv shello haya beolamo bezika!
Amar rabba: hu haddin deaf al gav dela avad ba maamar — sheniyya michlatz chaltza, yabbome la miyyaybma.
Veha dekatane maamar, leappoke mibbet shammay, deamri: maamar kone kinyan gamur — ka mashma lan.

Etiveh abbaye: shene achin beolam echad, vamet echad mehen belo valad, veamad hashsheni hazze laasot maamar bivimto, velo hispik laasot bah maamar ad shennolad lo ach, umet. harishona — yotza mishshum eshet achiv shello haya beolamo, usheniyya — o choletzet o mityaybemet. vei amrat yesh zika, havya la tzarat eshet achiv shello haya beolamo bezika!

Ha manni — rabbi meir hi, deamar: en zika. umi sevira leh lerabbi meir en zika? vehatnan: arbaa achim, shenayim mehen nesuim shete achayot, umetu hannesuin haachayot — hare ellu choltzot velo mityaybmot.
Vei salka datach savar rabbi meir en zika, hane mittere batte kaatyayn, hay leyaybem chada vehay leyaybem chada!
Leolam en zika. mishshum dekasavar asur levattel mitzvat yevamin — dedilma addimyaybem chad, mayet iddach, veka batlat mitzvat yevamin.
Vei en zika — tivtal! deha rabban gamliel amar: en zika, umuttar levattel mitzvat yevamin.
Ditnan, rabban gamliel omer: im meana — meana, veim lo meana — tamtin ad shettagdil, vetetze hallezu, mishshum achot ishsha.

Amar leh: derabban gamliel adderabbi meir karamet?! la, hachi kaamrinan: rabbi meir chayesh afillu lisfeka, rabban gamliel afillu levadday la chayesh! dilma man dela chayesh — afillu levadday la chayesh, uman dechayesh — afillu lisfeka chayesh.
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: ha derav yehuda — dishmuel hi. ditnan:
b: Shomeret yavam shekkiddesh achiv et achotah, mishshum rabbi yehuda ben betira amru: omrim lo: hameten ad sheyyaase achicha maase. veamar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yehuda ben betira.

Amar leh: dei derav may? (amar leh:) kashya derav adderav! dilma amorae ninhu, veallibba derav. kevan deittemar mishshemeh dishmuel behedya, umishshemeh derav keamorae — la shavkinan mishshemeh dishmuel behedya umokminan keamorae veallibba derav.

Amar rav kahana: amrita lishmata kammeh derav zevid minnehardea, amar: attun, hachi matnitu la! anan, behedya matnenan. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: shomeret yavam shemmeta — asur beimmah. alma kasavar yesh zika. veazda shemuel letameh, deamar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yehuda ben betira.

Utzerichi, dei ashmeinan yesh zika, hava amena: hane mille bechad, aval bitre — la, ka mashma lan. vei ashmeinan halacha kerabbi yehuda ben betira, hava amena: hane mille mechayyim, aval leachar mita — paka la zika, ka mashma lan dezika bichdi la paka.

Mishna shene achim, umet echad mehen, veyibbem hashsheni et eshet achiv, veachar kach nolad lahen ach, umet, harishona yotza mishshum eshet achiv shello haya beolamo, vehashsheniyya — mishshum tzaratah. asa bah maamar umet — hashsheniyya choletzet velo mityaybemet.
Rabbi shimon omer: meyaybem leezo mehen sheyyirtze, o choletz leezo mehen sheyyirtze.
Gemara amar rav oshaya: chaluk haya rabbi shimon af barishona. mimmay — middekatane mishna yattira.

Bava deresha leman katane la? illema lerabbanan, hasheta yibbem ulevassof nolad, dechi ashkecha — behettera ashkecha, asri rabbanan, nolad veachar kach yibbem, mibbaya? ella lav, lerabbi shimon itzterich,

Utena resha lehodiacha kocho derabbi shimon, utena sefa lehodiacha kochan derabbanan. uvedin hu deniflog rabbi shimon beresha, ella natar lehu lerabbanan ad dimsayyeymi lemilletayyhu, vahadar pelig alayyhu.
Ella eshet achiv shello haya beolamo lerabbi shimon hechi mashkachat la? bechad acha, umit, venolad lo ach. i name: bitre, vela yibbem, vela mit.
Bishlama yibbem veachar kach nolad, ki ashkecha — behettera ashkecha. ella nolad veachar kach yibbem — may tama? kasavar: yesh zika, vezika kichnusa damya.
Matkef la rav yosef: hasheta zika umaamar mesappeka leh lerabbi shimon i kichnusa damya i lav kichnusa damya, zika lechoda mibbaya?
May hi — ditnan: shelosha achin nesuin shalosh nashim nochriyyot, umet echad mehem, veasa bah sheni maamar, umet — hare ellu choltzot velo mityaybmot.
Shenneemar: "umet echad mehem ... yevamah yavo aleha", mi shealeha zikat yavam echad, velo shealeha zikat shene yevamin.
Rabbi shimon omer: meyaybem leezehu mehen sheyyirtze, vecholetz lashsheniyya. yabbome tarvayyhu la — dedilma yesh zika, vehavu shete yevamot habbaot

a: Mibbayit echad. yabbome chada veippetore[10] iddach — la, dedilma en zika kichnusa, vehavu lehu shete yevamot habbaot mishshene vattim. alma mesappeka leh!

Vechi tema: middeorayyta hachi name demiyyaybma chada umippatra chada, umidderabbanan hu deasur, gezera mishshum shemma yomru shete yevamot habbaot mishshene vattim — chada miyyaybma, veiddach mippatra bivvelo kelum,
Veha tama derabbi shimon, mishshum maamar velav maamar hu. detanya, amar lahem rabbi shimon lachachamim: im maamaro shel sheni maamar — eshet sheni hu boel.
Veim maamaro shel sheni eno maamar — eshet rishon hu boel.
Amar leh abbaye: vela shane lach ben zikat yavam echad lezikat shene yevamim? dilma ki amar rabbi shimon zika kichnusa damya — beyavam echad, aval bishne yevamin — la.
Umi shane leh lerabbi shimon? vehatanya, kelal amar rabbi shimon: kol shehalleda kodemet lannissuin — lo choletzet velo mityaybemet, nissuin (kodem) [kodmin] lalleda — o choletzet o mityaybemet.
May lav beyavam echad, vekatane: lo choletzet velo mityaybemet. la, bishne yevamim.

Aval beyavam echad may — hachi name o choletzet o mityaybemet? i hachi, addetane: nissuin kodmin lalleda — o choletzet o mityaybemet, liflog velitne bedida: bamme devarim amurim — bishne yevamim, aval beyavam echad — o choletzet o mityaybemet.
Kullah bishne yevamin kamayyre. veella may kelala?!
Veod, metiv rav oshaya: shelosha achin, shenayim mehen nesuin shete achayot, o ishsha uvittah, o ishsha uvat bittah, o ishsha uvat benah — hare ellu choltzot velo mityaybmot. verabbi shimon poter.
Vei salka datach kasavar rabbi shimon zika kichnusa damya — leyaybem lekammayyta, vetippetar iddach!
Amar rav amram: may poter, name poter bashsheniyya. vehatanya: rabbi shimon poter bishtehen!
Amar rava: sheniyya shebbezug ze, vehashsheniyya shebbezug ze.
Ka tae rava bearbea zuge: chada, deo" "o" katane. veod, "rabbi shimon poter bearbatan" mibbee leh.

Veod tanya: rabbi shimon poter bishtehen min hachalitza umin hayyibbum, shenneemar: "veishsha el achotah lo tikkach litzror", beshaa shennaasu tzarot zo lazo — lo yehe lecha likkuchin afillu beachat mehen!
Ella amar rav ashe: i dinful beze achar ze — hachi name, hacha bemay askinan — dinful bevat achat, verabbi shimon savar la kerabbi yose haggelili, deamar: efshar letzamtzem.
Rav pappa amar: beyibbem veachar kach nolad — pelig rabbi shimon, benolad veachar kach yibbem — la pelig.
Vetarvavyyhu lerabbanan itzterich, velo zo af zo katane.

Tanya kevoteh derav pappa, uteyuveta derabbi oshaya. shene achim beolam echad, umet echad mehem belo valad, veamad hashsheni hazze laasot maamar bivimto, velo hispik laasot bah maamar ad shennolad lo ach, umet — harishona yotza mishshum eshet achiv shello haya beolamo, usheniyya — o choletzet o mityaybemet.
Asa bah maamar, veachar kach nolad ach, o shennolad lo ach veachar kach asa bah maamar, umet — harishona yotza mishshum eshet achiv shello haya beolamo, usheniyya — choletzet velo mityaybemet.
b: Rabbi shimon omer: biatah o chalitzatah shel achat mehem poteret tzaratah, chalatz levaalat maamar — lo niftera tzara. kenasah vamet, veachar kach nolad lo ach, o shennolad lo ach veachar kach kenasah, vamet — shetehen peturot min hachalitza umin hayyibbum.

Kenasah venolad lo ach, veachar kach met — shetehen peturot min hachalitza umin hayyibbum, divre rabbi meir. verabbi shimon omer: hoil uva umetzaah behetter, velo amda alav shaa achat beissur — meyaybem leezo mehen sheyyirtze, o choletz leezo mehen sheyyirtze.
Ha bava desefa leman katane la? illema lerabbi meir katane la — mikkedi la shane leh lerabbi meir ben yibbem veachar kach nolad ben nolad veachar kach yibbem?! learvinhu velitninhu!
Ella lav rabbi shimon. uveyibbem veachar kach nolad — pelig, benolad veachar kach yibbem — la pelig. shema minna.

Amar mar: amad hashsheni laasot maamar bivimto, velo hispik laasot maamar bivimto ad shennolad lo ach, vamet — rishona yotza mishshum eshet achiv shello haya beolamo, usheniyya — o choletzet o mityaybemet. may "amad", umay "lo hispik"? i avad — avad, vei la avad — la avad!
Ella: "amad" — middatah, velo hispik" — middatah, ella beal korchah, udela kerabbi. detanya: haose maamar bivimto shello middatah, rabbi omer: kana, vachachamim omrim: lo kana.

May tama derabbi — gamar mibbia divama: ma bia divama — beal korchah, af kiddushin divama — beal korchah. verabbanan gamri mikkiddushin dealma: ma kiddushin dealma — middatah, af kiddushin divama — middatah.
Bemay kamippalgi? mar savar mille divama mimmille divama hava leh lemelaf, umar savar: mille dekiddushin mimmille dekiddushin hava leh lemelaf.

Asa bah maamar veachar kach nolad lo ach, o shennolad lo ach veachar kach asa bah maamar, vamet — rishona yotza mishshum eshet achiv shello haya beolamo, usheniyya — choletzet velo mityaybemet. rabbi shimon omer: biatah o chalitzatah shel achat mehen poteret tzaratah.
Rabbi shimon aheyay kae? illema annolad lo ach veachar kach asa bah maamar — ha amrat benolad ulevassof yibbem la pelig rabbi shimon. ella aasa bah maamar veachar kach nolad lo ach.
Chalatz levaalat maamar lo niftera tzara. may tama — mishshum dahavay tzara vadday, uvaalat maamar safek, veen safek motzi mide vadday.
Yatev rav menashshe bar zevid kammeh derav huna veyatev vekaamar: may tama derabbi shimon? may tama derabbi shimon?! kidamar tama: hoil uva umetzaah behetter, velo amda alav shaa achat beissur!

Ella: may tama derabbanan? amar kera: "ulekachah lo leishsha veyibbemah", adayin yibbumim harishonim aleha. ella ha ditnan: kenasah — hare hi keishto lechol davar. veamar rabbi yose bar chanina: melammed

a: Shemmegarsha beget, umachzirah. hatam name, lema "veyibbemah" — adayin yibbumin harishonim aleha, vetive chalitza!
Shane hatam deamar kera "ulekachah lo leishsha", kevan shellekachah — naaset keishto lechol davar. i hachi hacha name! ha ketav rachamana "veyibbemah".
Uma raita? mistabbera shedi hettera ahettera, ushedi issura aissura.

Ulerabbi shimon, deamar: hoil uva umetzaah behetter velo amda alav shaa achat beissur, ella meatta, achoto meimmo shennesaah achiv meaviv, veachar kach nolad ach, vamet — tityaybem, hoil uva umetzaah behetter!
Issur achoto lehechan azal?! hacha name: issur achiv shello haya baolam lehechan azal? hay issura delet leh hettera, hay issura deit leh hettera.
Mishna kelal amru bivama: kol shehi issur erva — lo choletzet velo mityaybemet. issur mitzva veissur kedushsha — choletzet velo mityaybemet.
Achotah shehi yevimtah — choletzet o mityaybemet.
Issur mitzva — sheniyyot middivre sofrim. issur kedushsha — almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, mamzeret unetina leyisrael, uvat yisrael lenatin umamzer.
Gemara kelal — leetoye may? amar rafram bar pappa: leetoye tzarat aylonit, vechidrav assi.
Veikka deamri: kol sheissurah issur erva, hu daasira tzarata, ha la issurah issur erva — tzarata la asira, lemaote may — amar rafram: lemaote tzarat aylonit, udela kerav assi.
Achotah shehi yevimtah. achotah deman? ilema deissur mitzva, kevan demiddeorayyta ramya kammeh, paga baachot zekukato! ella achotah deissur erva.
Issur mitzva — sheniyyot. ammay kare leh issur mitzva? amar abbaye: mitzva lishmoa divre chachamim.
Issur kedushsha — almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot. veammay kare lehu issur kedushsha — dichtiv: "kedoshim yihyu lelohehem".
Tanya, rabbi yehuda machlif: issur mitzva — almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot. veammay kare leh issur mitzva — dichtiv: "elle hammitzvot".

Issur kedushsha — sheniyyot middivre sofrim, veammay kare leh issur kedushsha? amar abbaye: kol hamekayyem divre chachamim nikra kadosh. amar leh rava: vechol sheeno mekayyem divre chachamim, kadosh hu dela mikkere, rasha name la mikkere! ella amar rava: kaddesh atzmecha bammuttar lach.
Almana lechohen gadol. kafasek vetane, la shena min hannissuin vela shena min haerusin.
Bishlama min hannissuin — ase velo taase, veen ase doche lo taase vaase. ella min haerusin — lo taase gereda hu, yavo ase veyidche lo taase!

Amar rav giddel amar rav, amar kera: "vealta yevimto hashshara", sheen talmud lomar "yevimto", ma talmud lomar "yevimto" — yesh lecha yevama achat sheola lachalitza veenah ola leyibbum, veezo zo chayyayve lavin.
Veema chayyayve karetot! amar kera: "veim lo yachpotz haish lakachat", ha chafetz — meyaybem. kol haole leyibbum — ole lachalitza, vechol sheen ole leyibbum — eno ole lachalitza.
I hachi, chayyayve lavin name! ha rabbi rachamana "yevimto". uma raita?
b: Mistabbera: chayyayve lavin — tafsi behu kiddushin. chayyayve karetot — la tafsi behu kiddushin.

Metiv rava: issur mitzva veissur kedushsha, ba aleha o chalatz lah — niftera tzaratah. vei salka datach chayyayve lavin middeorayyta lachalitza ramya, leyibbum la ramya, ki ba aleha — ammay niftera tzaratah?
Hu motev la vehu mefarek la: litzdadin katane. ba aleha — aissur mitzva. chalatz lah — aissur kedushsha.

Metiv rava: petzua dakka, ucherut shofcha, seris adam, vehazzaken — o choltzin o meyaybmin. ketzad? metu, velahem achim velahem nashim, veamdu achin veasu maamar binshotehen, venatnu get, vechaltzu — ma sheasu asu. veim baalu — kanu.

Metu achim, veamdu hem, veasu maamar binshotehen, venatnu get o shechaltzu — ma sheasu asu. veim baalu — kanu, veasur lekayyeyman, mishshum shenneemar: "lo yavo fetzua dakka". vei salka datach chayyayve lavin middeorayyta lachalitza ramya, leyibbum la ramya, im baalu — ammay kanu?
Ella amar rava: almana min haerusin name, ase velo taase hu — dichtiv: "kedoshim yihyu lelohehem".
Mamzeret unetina — may ikka lememar? ketiv: "vehitkaddishtem".
I hachi, kol hattora kullah name ase velo taase hu, dichtiv: "vehitkaddishtem"! ella amar rava: gezera almana min haerusin attu almana min hannissuin.
Mamzeret unetina may ikka lememar! gezera bimkom mitzva attu shello bimkom mitzva.
Ella meatta, eshet achiv meaviv lo tityaybem, gezera mishshum eshet achiv meimmo! yibbum benachala tela rachmana, midda yedia.
Ishsha sheen lah banim lo tityaybem, gezera mishshum ishsha sheyyesh lah banim! bevanim tela rachmana, midda yedia.
Eshet achiv shehaya beolamo lo tityaybem, gezera mishshum eshet achiv shello haya beolamo! bishiva tela rachmana, midda yedia.
Kol hannashim lo tityaybemna, gezera mishshum aylonit! la shechicha. mamzeret unetina name la shechicha!
Ella amar rava: gezera bia rishona attu bia sheniyya.
Tanya name hachi: im baalu — kanu bevia rishona, veasur lekayyeyman bevia sheniyya.

Hadar amar rava, veittema rav ashe: lav milleta hi daamari, deamar resh lakish: kol makom sheatta motze ase velo taase, im atta yachol lekayyem shenehem — mutav, veim lav, yavo ase veyidche et lo taase. hacha name efshar bachalitza, dimkayyem ase velo taase.
Metivi: veim baalu kanu. teyuveta.
Ittemar: biat kohen gadol bealmana. rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar, chad amar: enah poteret tzaratah, vechad amar: poteret tzaratah.

a: Bealmana min hannissuin — kulle alma la peligi dela patra, deen ase doche lo taase vaase. ki peligi bealmana min haerusin. man deamar poteret — ate ase vedache et lo taase. uman deamar enah poteret — la ate ase vedache et lo taase, kevan deefshar bachalitza.
Metivi: veim baalu kanu! teyuveta.
Lema tihve name teyuveta deresh lakish?! amar lach resh lakish: ki amena ana — hecha dimkayyeymi mitzva, aval hacha, chalitza bimkom yibbum — lav mitzva hi.
Amar rava: remez lishniyyot min hattora minnayin — shenneemar: "ki et kol hattoevot hael asu anshe haaretz", "hael" — kashot, mikkelal deikka rakkot, umay ninhu — sheniyyot.
Umay mashma dehael" lishshana dekashe hu — dichtiv: "veet ele haaretz lakach".
Lema peliga derabbi levi, deamar rabbi levi: kashe onshan shel middot yoter meonshan shel arayot, shezze neemar bahen "el", veze neemar bahen "elle"! "el" kashe, veelle" kashe meel".
Gabbe arayot name ha ketiv "elle"! hahu lemaote middot mikkaret.
Ella may chumerayyhu? hane — efshar bitshuva, hane — la efshar bitshuva.

Rav yehuda amar mehacha: "veizzen vechikker tikken meshalim harebe", veamar ulla amar rabbi elazar: kodem shebba shelomo, hayta tora doma lichfifa sheen lah oznayim, ad shebba shelomo veasa lah oznayim.
Rabbi oshaya amar mehacha: "peraehu al taavor bo sete mealav vaavor".

Amar rav ashe: mashal derabbi oshaya lema haddavar dome — leadam meshammer pardes, meshammero mibbachutz — kullo mishtammer. meshammero mibbifnim, shellefanav — mishtammer, shelleacharav — eno mishtammer. veha derav ashe beduta hi. hatam, shellefanav miha mishtammer. hacha, i lav sheniyyot, paga beerva gufa.
Rav kahana amar mehacha: "ushemartem et mishmarti" — asu mishmeret lemishmarti.
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: ha deorayyta hi! deorayyta, ufershu rabbanan. kol hattora name pershu rabbanan! ella: midderabbanan, ukera asmachta bealma.

Tanu rabbanan, ma hem sheniyyot: em immo, veem aviv, veeshet avi aviv, veeshet avi immo, veeshet achi haav min haem, veeshet achi haem min haav, vechallat beno, vechallat bitto. umuttar adam beeshet chamiv uveeshet chorgo, veasur bevat chorgo. vechorgo muttar beishto uvitto.
Veeshet chorgo omeret lo: ani mutteret lecha, uvitti asura lach.

Bat chorgo deorayyta hi, dichtiv: "et bat benah veet bat bittah"! mishshum dekavae lemitne sefa: eshet chorgo omeret lo: "ani mutteret lecha uvitti asura lecha", veaf al gav devitti asura lecha middeorayyta, bedidi la gezur bi rabbanan — tena resha name bat chorgo.
I hachi, eshet chamiv name tema: ani mutteret lecha uvitti asura lach, dehavya achot ishto! ha pesika leh, ha la pesika leh.

Amar rav, arba nashim yesh lahen hefsek. naket rav bideh telat: eshet achi haem min haav, veeshet achi haav min haem, vechallato. uzeeri mosif af eshet avi immo. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, vesimanaych: deillay, derav.
Verav may tama la chashev leh? michallefa leh beeshet avi aviv.
Uzeeri? lehatam shechiach veazel, lehacha la shechiach veazel.
Kallato
b: Deorayyta hi, dichtiv: "ervat kallatcha lo tegalle"! ema kallat beno. vechallat beno yesh lah hefsek? veha tanya: kallato erva, kallat beno sheniyya, vechen atta omer bivno uven beno ad sof kol haddorot. ella ema: kallat bitto.
Deamar rav chisda: ha milleta miggavra rabba shemia li, umannu — rabbi amme: lo asru kalla ella mippene kalla. vaamaru li kaldae: mallefana havet.
Amena: i gavra rabba havena — esbera middatay, i makre dardeke havena — eshayyeyla merabbanan deatu leve chenishta. hasheta sevarta middatay: lo asru kallat bitto ella mishshum kallat beno.
Amar leh abbaye lerava, asbera lach: kegon kallate deve bar tzetay. rav pappa amar: kegon kallate deve rav pappa bar abba. rav ashe amar: kegon kallate deve mari bar isak.

Ibbaya lehu: eshet achi haem min haem, mahu? eshet achi haav min haem veeshet achi haem min haav, deikka tzad av — hu digzaru rabbanan, aval hecha delekka tzad av — la gezaru behu rabbanan, o dilma la shena?

Amar rav safra: hi gufa gezera, vaanan nekum venigzor gezera ligzera?! amar rava: attu kullehu lav gezera ligzera ninhu? immo — erva, em immo — sheniyya, ugezaru al em aviv mishshum em immo. vetama may — kullehu "deve imma rabbati" karu lay.
Eshet aviv — erva, eshet avi aviv — sheniyya, ugezaru al eshet avi immo mishshum eshet avi aviv. vetama may — kullehu "deve abba rabba" karu leh.
Eshet achi haav min haav — erva, eshet achi haav min haem — sheniyya, vegazru al eshet achi haem min haav mishshum eshet achi haav min haem. vetama may — mishshum dechullehu "deve dode" kare lehu.
May? ta shema, dechi ata rav yehuda bar shela, amar: amri bemareva: kol shebbinkeva erva, bezachar gazru al ishto mishshum sheniyya.

Veamar rava: uchelala hu? chamoto erva, eshet chamiv mutteret. bat chamoto erva, eshet ben chamoto mutteret. bat chamiv erva, eshet ben chamiv mutteret. choragto erva, eshet chorgo mutteret. bat choragto erva, eshet ben chorgo mutteret!
Veha derav yehuda bar shela leetoye may? lav leetoye eshet achi haem min haem, dechol shebbinkeva erva, bezachar gazru ishto mishshum sheniyya?
May shena hane, umay shena ha? ha — bechad kiddushin mekarev la, hane — ad deikka tere kiddushin la mekarev lehu.
Shelach leh rav mesharsheya mittosanyay lerav pappe: yelammedenu rabbenu, eshet achi avi haav, vaachot avi haav, mahu? middilmatta erva — lemala name gezaru beh, o dilma, ha itpelig darata.
Ta shema "ma hen sheniyyot", vela kachashev lehu bahadayyhu!
Tena veshayyayr. may shayyer dehay shayyayr? shayyayr sheniyyot deve rabbi chiyyay.

Ammemar achshar beeshet achi avi aviv uvaachot avi aviv. amar leh rav hillel lerav ashe: ledidi chazya li sheniyyot mar bereh deravna, uchetivan shittasre leissura. may lav: tamne dematnita, veshet deve rabbi chiyyay, vehanach tarte — ha shittasre.
Uletamaych: shivsere havyayn, deha ikka eshet achi haem min haem, defashtinan leissura! ha la kashya,

a: Hanach tarte dedamyayn lahadade kachada chashev lehu, veha shittasre. veha mikkol makom ledidi chazyayn lan dichtivan leissura! amar leh: velitamaych, i hava ketiv lehettera, mi havevt samchat alayyhu? demar bereh deravna mi chatim alayyhu? hasheta name dichtiv leissura — lav mar bereh deravna chatim alayyhu.
Tane deve rabbi chiyyay: shelishi shebbivno veshebbevitto veshebbeven ishto veshebbevat ishto — sheniyya. revii shebbechamiv veshebbachamoto — sheniyya.

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: may shena lemala dekachashev lah leishto, umay shena lematta dela kachashev lah leishto? lemala, deissura mikkoach ishto ka ate — chashev la, lematta, deissura lav mikkoach ishto kaate — la kachashev la.
Veha ben ishto uvat ishto, deissura mikkoach ishto kaate, vela chashev la! ayyeyde ditna shelosha dorot lematta dideh vela chashsheva, tena name shelosha dorot lematta dida vela chashsheva.
Amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana: sheniyyot deve rabbi chiyyay, yesh lahen hefsek o en lahem hefsek?

Ta shema, deamar rav: arba nashim yesh lahem hefsek, vetu la. dilma ki kaamar rav — lehahi matnita. ta shema: shelishi urevii. shelishi urevii — in, tefe — la! dilma mishshelishi veelach, mervii veelach.
Amar leh rava lerav nachman: chazi mar hay merabbanan daata mimmareva veamar, beo bemareva: gazru sheniyyot begerim, o lo gazru sheniyyot begerim?
Amar leh: hasheta uma erva gufa, i lav "shello yomru bain mikkedushsha chamura likdushsha kalla", la gezaru behu rabbanan — sheniyyot mibbaya?!

Amar rav nachman: gerim, hoil vaato leyadan, nema behu milleta: achin min haem — lo yaidu, veim heidu edutan edut. achin min haav — meidin lechattechilla. ammemar amar: afillu achin min haem name meidin lechattechilla.
Umay shena mearayot? erva — lakkol mesura, edut — levet din mesura, veger shennitgayyer kekatan shennolad dame.

Mishna mi sheyyesh lo ach mikkol makom — zokek et eshet achiv leyibbum, veachiv hu lechol davar, chutz mimmi sheyyesh lo ach min hashshifcha umin haggoya. mi sheyyesh lo ben mikkol makom — poter eshet aviv min hayyibbum, vechayyayv al makkato veal killato, uveno lechol davar, chutz mimmi sheyyesh lo ben min hashshifcha umin haggoya.

Gemara mikkol makom leetoye may? amar rav yehuda: leetoye mamzer. peshita, achiv hu! mahu detema, lelaf achva achva mibbene yaakov: ma lehallan — kesherin velo pesulin, af kan — kesherin velo pesulin, ka mashma lan.
Veema hachi name? kevan dilinyan yibbum miftar niftar,
b: Mizkak name zakek.
Veachiv hu lechol davar. lemay hilcheta? leyorsho velittame lo.

Peshita, achiv hu! salka datach amena: hoil uchetiv: "ki im lishero hakkarov elav", veamar mar: "sheero" — zo ishto, uchetiv: "lo yittamma baal beammav lehechallo", yesh baal shemmittamme veyesh baal sheen mittamme, ha ketzad? mittamme hu leishto keshera, veen mittamme leishto pesula,
Hachi name: mittamme hu leach kasher, veen mittamme leach pesul — ka mashma lan. veema hachi name? hatam leappoke kayyma, hacha achiv hu.
Chutz mimmi sheyyesh lo ach min hashshifcha umin haggoya. may tama? amar kera: "haishsha viladeha tihye ladoneha".
Mi sheyyesh lo ben mikkol makom poter vechulei. "mikkol makom" leetoye may? amar rav yehuda: leetoye mamzer. may tama — deamar kera: "uven en lo" — ayyen alav.
Vechayyayv al makkato. ammay? keri kan: "venasi veammecha lo taor", beose maase ammecha!
Kidamar rav pinchas mishshemeh derav pappa: beose teshuva, hacha name kesheasa teshuva.
Vehay bar teshuva hu? vehatnan: shimon ben menasya omer: ezehu "meuvvavt lo yuchal litkon" — ze habba al haerva veholid mimmenna mamzer! hasheta miha ose maase ammecha hu.

Tanu rabbanan: habba al achoto, vehi bat eshet aviv — chayyayv mishshum achoto umishshum bat eshet aviv. rabbi yose ben yehuda omer: eno chayyayv ella mishshum achoto bilvad, velo mippene bat eshet aviv.

May tamayyhu derabbanan? amri, mikkede ketiv: "ervat achotcha vat avicha o vat immecha", "ervat bat eshet avicha moledet avicha achotcha hi" lema li? shema minna lechayyeyvo mishshum achoto umishshum bat eshet aviv.
Verabbi yose berabbi yehuda, amar kera: "achotcha hi". mishshum achoto atta mechayyeyvo, vei atta mechayyeyvo mishshum bat eshet aviv.
Verabbanan, hay "achotcha hi" may avdi leh? mibbee lehu lechayyeyvo al achoto bat aviv uvat immo, lomar sheen mazhirin min haddin.
Verabbi yose berabbi yehuda: im ken, lichtov rachamana "achotcha", "hi" lema li? mishshum "achotcha" atta mechayyeyvo, vei atta mechayyeyvo mishshum "bat eshet aviv".
Verabbanan: af al gav dichtiv "achotcha", itzterich lemichtav "hi", shello tomar bealma mazhirin min haddin,
Vechi tema: "achotcha" dichtav rachamana lema li? milleta deatya bekal vechomer, tarach vechatav la kera — ketav rachamana "hi".
Verabbi yose berabbi yehuda: im ken, lichteveh rachamana laachotcha hi" beiddach kera.
Verabbi yose berabbi yehuda, hay "bat eshet avicha" may aved leh? mibbee leh: mi sheyyesh lo ishut leavicha bah, perat laachoto mishshifcha vegoya, sheen ishut leavicha bah.
Veema: perat laachoto meanusa? hahi la matzet amrat midderava,
Derava rame, ketiv: "ervat bat bincha o vat bittecha lo tegalle", ha bat benah dida uvat bittah dida shere, uchetiv: "ervat ishsha uvittah lo tegalle et bat benah veet bat bittah", ha ketzad?
Kan baonasin, kan benissuin.

a: Veema: perat lechayyayve lavin! amar rav pappa: chayyayve lavin tafsi behu kiddushin,

Dichtiv: "ki tihyena leish shete nashim haachat ahuva vehaachat senua", vechi yesh ahuva lifne hammakom veyesh senua lifne hammakom? ella: "ahuva" — ahuva benissueha, "senua" — senua benissueha, veamar rachamana: "ki tihyena".

Veema: perat lechayyayve karetot! amar rava, amar kera: "ervat achotcha vat avicha o vat immecha moledet bayit o moledet chutz", ben sheomrim lo leavicha kayyem, ben sheomrim lo leavicha hotze, veamar rachamana: "achotcha hi".

Ema: ben sheomer lo avicha kayyem, ben sheomer lo avicha hotze, veamar rachamana: "achotcha hi", lerabbot achoto mishshifcha vegoya! amar kera: "bat eshet avicha" — mi sheyyesh lo ishut leavicha bah, perat laachoto mishshifcha vegoya.
Uma raita? mistabbera chayyayve karetot hava leh lerabbot, shekken tafsi bahen kiddushin lealma.
Adderabba: shifcha vegoya hava leh lerabbot, dei miggayyeyra ledideh name, tafsi ba kiddushin! lechi miggayyeyra — gufa acharina hi.
Verabbanan, lemaote shifcha vegoya mena lehu? nafka lehu mehaishsha viladeha tihye ladoneha".
Verabbi yose berabbi yehuda? chad beshifcha, vechad begoya. utzerichi, dei ashmeinan shifcha: mishshum deen lah chayis, aval goya deit la chayis — ema la.
Vei ashmeinan goya — mishshum dela shayycha bemitzvot. aval shifcha, deshayycha bemitzvot — ema la, tzericha.
Verabbanan, ashkechan shifcha, goya mena lehu? vechi tema: nelaf mishshifcha — hanhu mitzrach tzerichi!
Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay, amar kera: "ki yasir et bincha meacharay", bincha miyyisreelit karuy bincha, veen bincha habba min haggoya karuy bincha, ella benah.

Amar ravina, shema minna: ben bittecha habba min haggoy karuy bincha. lema kasavar ravina goy veeved habba al bat yisrael havvalad kasher? nehi demamzer la have — kasher name la have, yisrael pasul mikkere.
Hay beshiva goyim ketiv? "ki yasir" — lerabbot kol hammesirim.
Hanicha lerabbi shimon, dedaresh tama dikra, ella lerabbanan mena lehu? man tanna diflig aleh derabbi yose berabbi yehuda — rabbi shimon hi.
b: Mishna mi shekkiddesh achat mishte achayot, veen yodea e zo mehen kiddesh — noten get lazo veget lazo. met velo ach echad — choletz lishtehen.
Hayu lo shenayim — echad choletz veechad meyaybem. kadmu vechansu — en motziin miyyadam.

Shenayim shekkiddeshu shete achayot, ze eno yodea e zo kiddesh, veze eno yodea ezo kiddesh — ze noten shene gittin, veze noten shene gittin. metu, laze ach velaze ach — ze choletz lishtehen, veze choletz lishtehen.

Laze echad velaze shenayim — hayyachid choletz lishtehen, vehashshenayim — echad choletz, veechad meyaybem. kadmu vechansu, en motziin miyyadam. laze shenayim velaze shenayim — achiv shel ze choletz leachat, veachiv shel ze choletz leachat. achiv shel ze meyaybem chalutzato shel ze, veachiv shel ze meyaybem chalutzato shel ze.
Kadmu shenayim vechaltzu — lo yeyabbemu hashshenayim, ella echad choletz veechad meyaybem. kadmu vechansu — en motziin miyyadam.
Gemara shema minna: kiddushin sheen mesurin levia — havu kiddushin!
Hacha bemay askinan — keshehukkeru ulevassof nitarvu. dayka name, dekatane: "veeno yodea", vela katane: "veeno yadua". shema minna.

May ka mashma lan? sefa itztericha leh: met velo ach echad — choletz lishtehen, hayu lo shenayim — echad choletz veechad meyaybem. davka michlatz vahadar yabbome, aval yabbome beresha — la, deka paga baachot zekukato.

Shenayim shekkiddeshu shete achayot vechulei. shema minna: kiddushin sheen mesurin levia — havu kiddushin! hacha name, keshehukkeru ulevassof nitarvu. dayka name, dekatane: "veen yodea", vela katane "veen yadua". shema minna.
Umay ka mashma lan? sefa itztericha leh: metu, laze echad velaze shenayim — hayyachid choletz lishtehen, vehashshenayim — echad choletz veechad meyaybem.
Peshita, hayeynu resha! mahu detema: ligzor tere attu chad, ka mashma lan.
Vedavka michlatz vahadar yabbome, aval yabbome beresha — la, deka paga bivama lashshuk.
Laze shenayim velaze shenayim vechulei. ha tu lema li? hayeynu hach! mahu detema: ligzor dilma meyaybem belo chalitza, ka mashma lan.
May shena meha ditnan: arbaa achin, shenayim mehen nesuin shete achayot, umetu hannesuin et haachayot — hare ellu choltzot velo mityaybmot?
Hachi hasheta?!

a: Hatam, i leman deamar yesh zika — yesh zika, vei leman deamar asur levattel mitzvat yevamin — asur levattel mitzvat yevamin. hacha — kol chad vechad emor dideh ka mitramya leh.
Kadmu vechansu en motziin kulei. tane shela: vaafillu shenehem kohanim. may tama — chalutza derabbanan hi, vesafek chalutza la gezaru behu rabbanan.
Vachalutza derabbanan hi? vehatanya: "gerusha", en li ella gerusha, chalutza minnayin? talmud lomar: "veishsha"! midderabbanan hu, ukera asmachta bealma hu.
Mishna mitzva baggadol leyaybem, veim kadam hakkatan — zacha.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "vehaya habbechor" — mikkan shemmitzva baggadol leyaybem. "asher teled" — perat leaylonit, sheen yoledet. "yakum al shem achiv" — lenachala.

Atta omer lenachala, o eno ella leshem: yosef — korin oto yosef, yochanan — korin oto yochanan. neemar kan "yakum al shem achiv", veneemar lehallan: "al shem achehem yikkaru benachalatam", ma shem haamur lehallan — nachala, af shem haamur kan — lenachala.
"Velo yimmache shemo" — perat lesaris sheshshemo machuy.
Amar rava: af al gav divchol hattora kullah en mikra yotze mide feshuto — hacha atay gezera shava appekteh mippeshateh ligmare.
Vei lav gezera shava, hava amena "shem" — shem mammash? leman kamazhar rachamana? leyavam — "yakum al shem achicha" mibbee leh! i leve dina — "yakum al shem achi aviv" mibbee leh!
Vedilma hachi kaamar lehu rachamana levet din: emaru leh leyavam "yakum al shem achiv". ella atay gezera shava appekteh ligmare.
Hasheta deamrat kera begadol ketiv, ema: bechor — leyaybem, pashut — la leyaybem!
Im ken, eshet achiv shello haya beolamo demiet rachamana — lema li?
Parech rav acha: veema lemaote buchera deimma! hahu la matzet amrat — deyibbum benachala tela rachamana, venachala min haav velo min haem.
Veema: ki ikka bechor titkayyem mitzvat yibbum, ki lekka bechor lo titkayyem mitzvat yibbum! amar kera: "umet achad mehem", mi la askinan demit bechor, veamar rachamana: leyaybem katan.
Veema demit katan, veamar rachamana leyaybem bechor? ha miet rachamana eshet achiv shello haya beolamo.
Veema: ki lekka bechor, kedam katan — zecha. vei ikka bechor, kedam katan — la zecha! amar kera: "ki yeshvu achim yachdav" — hukkesha yeshivat achim ze laze.

Veema: ki ikka bechor — lehdar aggadol. ki lekka bechor — en chozrin etzel gadol! allema tane abbaye kashshisha: mitzva baggadol leyaybem, lo ratza — holchim etzel achiv hakkatan, lo ratza — chozrin etzel gadol!
Kivchor: ma bechor — bechorato garma lo, af gadol — gedullato garma lo.
Veema: ki meyaybem bechor — lishkol nachala, ki meyaybem pashut — la lishkol nachala. amar kera: "yakum al shem achiv", vahare kam.
Veella "bechor" dekaryeh rachamana,
b: Lemay hilcheta? ligriuta: ma bechor eno notel barauy kivmuchezak — af hay eno notel barauy kivmuchezak.

Mishna hannitan al hashshifcha venishtachrera, o al haggoya venitgayyeyra — hare ze lo yichnos. veim kanas — en motziin miyyado. hannitan al eshet ish vehotziuha mittachat yado, af al pi shekkanas — yotzi.

Gemara ha giyyoret miha havya. ureminhi: echad ish shennitgayyer leshum ishsha, veechad ishsha shennitgayyeyra leshum ish, vechen mi shennitgayyer leshum shulechan melachim, leshum avde shelomo — enan gerim, divre rabbi nechemya.
Shehaya rabbi nechemya omer: echad gere arayot, veechad gere chalomot, veechad gere mordochay veester — enan gerim ad sheyyitgayyeyru bazzeman hazze.
Bazzeman hazze salka datach?! ella ema: kevazzeman hazze.
Ha ittemar ala, amar rav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta mishshemeh derav: halacha kedivre haomer kullam gerim hem.
I hachi, lechattechilla name! mishshum derav assi. deamar rav assi: "haser mimmecha ikkeshut pe ulezut sefatayim vegomer".

Tanu rabbanan: en mekabbelin gerim limot hammashiach. kayyotze bo, lo kibbelu gerim lo bime david velo bime shelomo. amar rabbi eliezer, may kera: "hen gor yagur efes meoti mi gar ittach alayich yippol", aval iddach la.
Hannitan al eshet ish vechulei. amar rav: uveedim.
Amar rav sheshet: amena, ki nayem veshachev rav amar lehay shematata. detanya: hannitan al eshet ish vehotziuha al yado, venitgarsha mittachat yede acher, im kanas — lo yotzi.
Hechi dame: i deikka edim, ki ata acher veafsekeh lekala may have? ella lav delekka edim, vetama daata acher veafsekeh lekala, ha lav hachi, mappekinan!

Amar lecha rav: hu haddin deaf al gav dela ata acher veafsekeh lekala, i ikka edim — mappekinan, i lekka edim — la mappekinan, vehachi kaamar: deaf al gav daata acher veafsekeh lekala, lechattechilla lo yichnos.
Metivi: bamme devarim amurim — kesheen lah banim, aval yesh lah banim — lo tetze. veim bau ede tumea, afillu yesh lah kamma banim — tetze.
