Rav moke la lematnitin beyesh lah banim veyesh lah edim. umay duchekeh derav leokome lematnitin beyesh lah banim veyesh lah edim, vetama deikka edim mappekinan, vei lekka edim la mappekinan? lokma besheen lah banim, af al gav delekka edim!
Amar rava: matnitin keshiteh. may irya detane "hotziuha"? litne "hotziah"! ella: kol "hotziuha" — bevet din, uvet din beedim hu demappeki.

Vei baet ema: hane matneyayta — rabbi hi. detanya: rochel yotze, veishsha chogeret besinar, amar rabbi: hoil umechoar haddavar — tetze. rok lemala min hakkila, amar rabbi: hoil umechoar haddavar — tetze.

a: Minalim hafuchim tachat hammitta, amar rabbi: hoil umechoar haddavar — tetze. minalim hafuchim? lichze deman ninhu! ella: mekom minalim hafuchim (tachat hammitta, amar rabbi: hoil umechoar haddavar — tetze).

Vehilcheta kevoteh derav, vehilcheta kevoteh derabbi. kashya hilcheta ahilcheta: la kashya, ha — bekala defasek, ha — bekala dela pasek. kala dela pasek velekka edim — kerabbi. kala defasek veikka edim — kerav.

Vekala dela pasek ad kamma? amar abbaye, amara li em: dome demata yoma ufalga. vela amaran, ella dela pesak bene uvene, aval pesak bene uvene — ha pesak. vela amaran ella dela pesak mechamat yira, aval pesak mechamat yira — mechamat yira hu. vela amaran ella delekka oyvim, aval ikka oyvim — oyvim hu deappiku leh lekala.
Tenan hatam: hammotzi et ishto mishshum shem ra — lo yachzir. mishshum neder — lo yachzir. shelach leh rabba bar huna lerabba bar rav nachman, yelammedenu rabbenu: kanas, mahu sheyyotzi?

Amar leh: tenena, hannitan al eshet ish vehotziah mittachat yado, af al pi shekkanas — yotzi. amar leh: mi dame? hatam "hotziuha" vehacha "hotziah". verabba bar rav nachman, matnitin name "hotziah" tenan.
Veakkatti mi dame? hacha baal, vehatam boel! amar leh: shappir dame ahadade. hacha amur rabbanan: la yichnos, veim kanas — yotzi. hachi name: amri rabbanan, lo yachzir, veim kanas — yotzi.
Vela hi. hatam: allome allemeh lekala, hacha: amrinan kam beh bekala veleteh.

Mishna hammevi get mimmedinat hayyam, veamar: "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam" — lo yissa et ishto. "met", "haragtiv", "haragnuhu" — lo yissa et ishto. rabbi yehuda omer: "haragtiv" — lo tinnase ishto, "haragnuhu" — tinnase ishto.
Gemara tama demimmedinat hayyam, daaleh kasamchinan. aval meeretz yisrael, delav aleh kasamchinan — yissa et ishto.
Veha met, delav aleh kasamchinan, deamar mar: ishsha dayyka uminnasva, vekatane: lo yissa et ishto!
Hatam lekka ketava, hacha ikka ketava. ditnan: ma ben get lemita — shehakketav mochiach.
"Met", "haragtiv", "haragnuhu" — lo yissa et ishto. hu nihu delo yissa et ishto, ha leacher tinnase.
Vehaamar rav yosef: "peloni revaani leonsi" — hu veacher mitztarfin lehorgo. "lirtzoni" — rasha hu, vehattora amra: "al tashet yadcha im rasha lihyot ed chamas"?
Vechi tema: shane edut ishsha daakillu ba rabbanan — vehaamar rav menashshe:
b: Gazlan dedivrehem — kasher leedut ishsha, gazlan dedivre tora — pasul leedut ishsha. nema rav menashshe deamar kerabbi yehuda!
Amar lecha rav menashshe: ana daamari afillu lerabbanan — vetama derabbanan hacha kidrava, deamar rava: adam karov etzel atzmo, veen adam mesim atzmo rasha.
Lema rav yosef deamar kerabbi yehuda? amar lecha rav yosef: ana daamari afillu lerabbanan, veshane edut ishsha, daakillu ba rabbanan. verav menashshe deamar kerabbi yehuda.
Haragtiv kulei haragnuhu tinnase kulei. may shena "haragtiv" umay shena "haragnuhu"? amar rav yehuda, beomer: ani hayiti im horgav.

Vehatanya: amru lo lerabbi yehuda, maase belistim echad sheyyatza lehareg bimgizat kappotkeya, veamar lahem: "lechu imru lah leeshet shimon ben kohen: 'ani haragti et balah bichnisati lelod", veamri la: 'bichnisato lelod, vehissiu et ishto! amar lahem: mishsham reaya?! beomer: "ani hayiti im horgav".
Veha "listim" katane! shennitpas al yede listiyyut. veha "yatza" lehareg katane! be dina degoyim, dela dayyki vekatli.
Mishna hechacham sheasar et haishsha beneder al balah — hare ze lo yissaenna. meana, o shechaltza befanav — yissaenna, mippene shehu bet din.
Gemara ha hittira — yissaenna. bemay askinan? ilema bechad — chad mi matze mattir? vehaamar (rav amar) rabbi chiyyay bar avin amar rav amram, tana: hattarat nedarim bishlosha!
Veella, bitlata. mi chashidi? vehatnan: meana o shechaltza befanav — yissaenna, mippene shehu bet din.
Leolam bechad, vechidamar rav chisda amar rabbi yochanan: beyachid mumeche, hacha name: beyachid mumeche.
Meana o shechaltza vechulei. tama devet din, ha bitre — la,
May shena meha ditnan: edim hachatumim al sede mikkach, veal get ishsha lo chashu chachamim ledavar ze? hi gufa kamashma lan, leappoke mimman deamar meun bifne shenayim, kamashma lan meun bishlosha.
Ibbaya lehu: kanas, mahu sheyyotzi? rav kahana amar: kanas — motzi. rav ashe amar: kanas — eno motzi. tane lehu rav zute deve rav pappe kedivre haomer kanas eno motzi.
Amaru leh rabbanan lerav ashe: gemara, o sevara? amar lehu, matnitin hi: hannitan mishshifcha venishtachrera, miggoya venitgayyeyra — hare ze lo yichnos, veim kanas — en motzi. alma

a: Birnana — la mappekinan, hacha name — birnana la mappekinan.
Mishna vechullam shehayu lahem nashim umetu — muttarot linnase lahem.
Vechullan shennisseu laacherim, venitgarshu o shennitalmenu — muttarot linnase lahem. vechullan muttarot livnehem o laachehem.
Gemara metu — in, nitgarshu — la.
Amar leh rav hillel lerav ashe, vehatanya: afillu nitgarshu! la kashya: ha dahavay ketata, ha dela havay ketata.
Veibbaet ema: ha veha dela havay ketata, vela kashya: ha deargel hu, ha deargila hi.
Vechullan shennisseu vechulei. ka salka datin mita ammita, vegerushin aggerushin.
Nema matnitin dela kerabbi, dei kerabbi, haamar: bitre zimne havya chazaka!
La: mita aggerushin, vegerushin ammita.
Vechullan muttarot livnehem o laachehem. may shena meha ditnan: hannitan min haishsha, asur beimmah uvevittah uvaachotah.
Neshe legabbe neshe shechichan deazlan. gavre legabbe gavre la shechichan.
I name: neshe dela asran shechivatan ahadade, la kafdi ahadade. gavre deasran shechivatan ahadade, kafdi ahadade.
I hachi, aviv name? la mibbaya kaamar: la mibbaya aviv, divziz beneh minneh, aval beno, dela beziz aviv minneh — ema la, ka mashma lan.
Hadaran alach ketzad eshet achiv

Arbaa achin, shenayim mehem nesuim shete achayot, umetu hannesuim et haachayot — hare ellu choltzot velo mityaybmot. veim kadmu vechansu — yotziu. rabbi eliezer omer, bet shammay omrim: yekayyem, uvet hillel omrim: yotziu.
Hayta achat mehen asura al haechad issur erva — asur bah, umuttar baachotah. vehashsheni — asur bishtehen.
Issur mitzva veissur kedushsha — choletzet velo mityaybemet.
Hayta achat mehen asura al ze issur erva, vehashsheniyya asura al ze issur erva — haasura laze mutteret laze, vehaasura laze mutteret laze.
Vezo hi sheamru: achotah keshehi yevimtah — o choletzet o mityaybemet.
Gemara shema minna: yesh zika. dei en zika, mikkedi hane mittere vatte kaatyayn — hay leyaybem chada vehay leyaybem chada?
Leolam ema lach en zika, umishshum dekasavar asur levattel mitzvat yevamin. dilma addimyaybem chad — mayet iddach, vekamvattel mitzvat yevamin.
I hachi, telata name?
La mibbaya kaamrinan: la mibbaya telata, devadday batla mitzvat yevamin. aval arbea, lemita la chayyshinan — ka mashma lan.
I hachi —
b: Chamsha name! lemita ditre la chayyshinan.
Amar rava bar rav huna amar rav: shalosh achayot yevamot shennaflu lifne shene achin yevamin — ze choletz leachat veze choletz leachat, veemtzait tzericha chalitza mishshenehem.
Amar leh rabba: middekaamrat emtzait tzericha chalitza mishshenehem, kasavrat yesh zika, vehavya la chalitza pesula — vachalitza pesula tzarich lachazor al kol haachin,
I hachi, kammayyta name!
I dinful bevat achat — hachi name. la tzericha: dinful bezo achar zo.
Nefala chada — chaletz la reuven, nefala iddach — chaletz la shimon,
Nefala iddach, chaletz la hay — mafka zikato, chaletz la hay — mafka zikato.
Vehaamar rav: en zika! ledivre haomer yesh zika kaamar.
Ushemuel amar: echad choletz lechullan. mikkedi shaminan leh lishmuel deamar: chalitza mealleya beenan, deamar shemuel:

a: Chalatz laachayot — lo nifteru tzarot. hecha dekayyma chalitza deshimon chalitza keshera, chaletz la reuven chalitza pesula?

May "echad choletz lechullan" name dekaamar — aemtzait. veha "kullan" kaamar! kevan derubba gabbeh, kare leh "kullan". veibbaet ema: ki kaamar shemuel chalitza mealleya beenan — hane mille lemiftar tzaratah, aval miftaro nafsha — patra.
Gufa. amar shemuel: chalatz laachayot — lo nifteru tzarot, letzarot — nifteru achayot. chalatz levaalat hagget — lo niftera tzara, letzara — niftera baalat hagget.
Chalatz levaalat hammaamar — lo niftera tzara. letzara — niftera baalat maamar.
May shena laachayot delo nifteru tzarot — dehavya (lo) [la] achot ishsha bezika? chalatz letzarot name, la lippatru achayot — dehavya lehu tzarot achot ishsha bezika! kasavar shemuel: en zika.
Veha amar shemuel yesh zika! ledivre haomer en zika kaamar.

I hachi, chalatz laachayot, ammay lo nifteru tzarot? bishlama tzara derachel la tippetar, dechevan dechaletz la lelea, vahadar chaletz lerachel, havya la chalitza derachel chalitza pesula. ella tzara delea tippetar!
May "lo nifteru tzarot" name dekaamar — atztzara derachel. veha "tzarot" kaamar! tzarot dealma.
I hachi: "chalatz letzarot nifteru achayot", veatztzarat rachel mi mippatra? veha tenan: asur adam betzarat kerovat chalutzato!

Shemuel name, hitchil velo hitchil kaamar: hitchil baachayot — lo yigmor betzarot, ditnan: asur adam betzarat kerovat chalutzato. hitchil betzarot — yigmor af baachayot. ditnan: muttar adam bikrovat tzarat chalutzato.
Rav ashe amar: leolam kidkaamrat, umishshum dela allima zika leshauoye letzara keerva.
Tanya kevoteh derav ashe: chalatz laachayot — lo nifteru tzarot. ha letzarot — nifteru achayot. may tama — lav mishshum dekasavar yesh zika, vela allima zika leshauoyay letzara keerva?
Amar rabbi abba bar memel: ha manni — bet shammay hi. ditnan: bet shammay mattirin hatztzarot laachin. i hachi, yabbome name tityaybem?

Kerabbi yochanan ben nuri, deamar: bou unetakken lahen latztzarot sheyyehu choltzot velo mityaybmot. vehaamar mar: la hispiku ligmor et haddavar ad shennitrefa hashshaa! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: acharav chazru vetikkenu.
Ibbaya lehu:
b: Baalat hagget uvaalat maamar, ezo mehen kodemet? baalat hagget adifa, mishshum deatchel ba bachalitza, o dilma: baalat maamar adifa, mishshum dikrova levia.
Amar rav ashe, ta shema: umode rabban gamliel sheyyesh get achar maamar, umaamar acher get.
I get adif — la layhane maamar abbatreh, vei maamar adif — la layhane get abbatreh, ella lav shema minna: ki hadade ninhu, shema minna.
Amar rav huna amar rav: shete achayot yevamot shennaflu lifne yavam echad, chalatz larishona — huttera, chalatz lashsheniyyay — huttera.
Meta rishona — muttar bashsheniyyay. veen tzarich lomar meta sheniyyay shemmuttar barishona, mishshum dehavya yevama shehuttera veneesra vechazra vehuttera — tachzor lehetterah harishon.

Verabbi yochanan amar: meta sheniyyay — muttar barishona, aval meta rishona — asur bashsheniyyay. may tama? shekkol yevama sheen ani kore bah bishat nefila "yevamah yavo aleha" — hare zo keeshet ach sheyyesh lah banim, vaasura.

Verav let leh hay sevara? vehaamar rav: kol ishsha sheen ani kore bah bishat nefila "yevamah yavo aleha" — hare hi keeshet ach sheyyesh lo banim, vaasura! hane mille hecha dekae beappa issur achot ishsha deorayyta, aval hacha — zikka derabbanan hi.

Etiveh rabbi yose bar chanina lerabbi yochanan: arbaa achin, shenayim mehem nesuim shete achayot, umetu hannesuin et haachayot — hare ellu choltzot velo mityaybmot. veammay? leku chad minnayyhu, lachlotz lah lishniyyay, vetihve rishona legabbe iddach kivama shehuttera veneesra vechazra vehuttera — tachzor lehetterah harishon!
Amar leh: achayot eni yodea mi shenaan. velema leh: may "choltzot" name dekatane — choletzet chada! "choltzot" katane.
Velema leh: may "choltzot" — choltzot dealma! "hare ellu" katane. velema: dachaletz lay lerishona beresha! "choltzot"
